title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
english: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has finalized a new agreement with the EU that relaxes food export checks, establishes a youth mobility scheme for thousands of young people, and links emissions trading. The UK government expects this deal to generate up to £17 billion annually for the economy, though opposition leaders have criticized it as a compromise on national sovereignty. Following this progress, the administration plans to continue negotiations to further strengthen ties with the European Union.

title: Gérard Depardieu and French author investigated over sexual allegations
english: French authorities have launched a formal investigation into actor Gérard Depardieu and author Michel Houellebecq following accusations of sexual assault during the 2018 filming of the movie Thalasso. An unnamed actress claims the two men forced her to engage in non-consensual sexual acts that were not part of the script. The film's director is also under scrutiny for allegedly recording the encounter, though he denies witnessing any signs of distress.

oromo: Mootummaan Faransaay, gartuun aktara Jeeraard Diipaardiyuu fi barreessaa Miishel Huulbeek jedhaman, bara 2018 yeroo fiilmii 'Thaalaasoo' hojjetamaa turetti gocha saalaa dirqisiisuun raawwataniiru jedhamanii qorannoo keessa galaniiru. Akkaataa himannaa ishee, aktariin maqaan ishee hin ibsamne tokko dhiironni kun lamaan dirqisiisanii walqunnamtii saalaa raawwachuu ishee fi kunis seenaa fiilmichaa keessatti kan hin jirre ta'uu ibsiteetti. title: Anthropic shares fall after blockbuster opening as wider tech sell-off continues
english: Anthropic’s stock price declined shortly after a strong market debut, settling back toward its initial offering value. This drop is part of a broader sell-off in the technology sector that has significantly impacted major U.S. stock indexes. Investors are increasingly cautious about the high costs of artificial intelligence investments and whether these massive expenditures will generate long-term profits.

Investeronni baasii guddaa teeknoolojii ofiin of-guddistu (AI) irratti taasifamuufi bu'aan isaa gara fuulduraatti maal akka fakkaatu irratti shakkiin isaanitti dhaga'amaa jira.

title: Russia complains of ‘new Iron Curtain’ as Estonia shuts its borders
english: Estonia has announced a temporary closure of its road border crossings with Russia starting in December, citing security concerns and the need to prevent sabotage. Russian officials have criticized this decision, labeling it a modern 'Iron Curtain' and threatening to take retaliatory diplomatic measures. The Estonian government claims the move is essential to stop illegal influence operations and prevent the circumvention of sanctions.

title: Israeli drone attacks kill seven Palestinians in central Gaza
english: Israeli drone strikes in central Gaza have resulted in the deaths of at least seven Palestinians, despite an active ceasefire agreement. These attacks hit multiple refugee camps and residential areas, causing widespread fear among the local population who are struggling with limited medical resources. Ongoing military operations and building demolitions continue to disrupt lives across the region.

title: Nepali cricket fans in Qatar want to see their team competing with the best
english: Thousands of Nepali expatriates in Qatar gathered at the West End International Cricket Stadium to support their national cricket team during a match against India A. The passionate fans, who traveled from across the country to watch their team, expressed pride in Nepal's growing presence on the global cricket stage. This event highlighted the strong connection between the Nepali diaspora and their home country's sporting progress.

title: Palestinian anti-Hamas groups accused of role in Israel Gaza operation
english: Local Palestinian militias allegedly backed by Israel are playing an increasing role in military operations within the Gaza Strip. Witnesses reported these armed groups intimidated civilians and forced them to evacuate their homes shortly before an Israeli military offensive took place in the Nuseirat and Bureij camps. This development has sparked significant concern regarding the future of Gaza’s security and the growing coordination between these militias and Israeli forces.

title: Indian man sentenced to 19 years in US Sikh separatist assassination plot
english: A 55-year-old Indian national, Nikhil Gupta, has been sentenced to over 19 years in a US prison for his role in a murder-for-hire scheme targeting a Sikh separatist living in New York. Gupta admitted to conspiring with an Indian government official to hire an undercover officer to assassinate activist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun. Following the completion of his prison sentence, Gupta will face deportation back to India.
amharic: ኒኪል ጉፕታ የተባለ የህንድ ዜጋ በኒውዮርክ በሚኖር የሲክ መገንጠል አቀንቃኝ ላይ የግድያ ሴራ በማቀነባበሩ በአሜሪካ ፍርድ ቤት ከ19 ዓመት በላይ እስራት ተፈረደበት። ጉፕታ ከአንድ የህንድ መንግስት ባለስልጣን ጋር በመሆን የሲክ አክቲቪስቱን ጉርፓትዋንት ሲንግ ፓኑንን ለመግደል በድብቅ የተላከን መኮንን ቀጣሪ መሆኑን አምኗል። እስራቱን ከጨረሰ በኋላም ወደ ህንድ እንዲባረር ይደረጋል።
oromo: Lammiin Indiyaa Nikhil Gupta jedhamu, Niiwuyorkitti kan jiraatu fi kan adda ba'uu barbaadu hogganaa Siikii tokko ajjeesuuf shiruu isaa irraa kan ka'e, mana hidhaa Ameerikaa keessatti waggaa 19 ol itti murteeffameera. Gupta hogganticha ajjeesuuf nama dhoksaan hojjetu qacaruuf aangessaa mootummaa Indiyaa tokko waliin shiruu isaa fudhateera. Hidhaa isaa erga xumuree boodas gara Indiyaatti kan deebi'u ta'a.

title: US right-wing voices attack Islam online after a study projects global Muslim majority by 2035
english: A recent Pew Research Center study projecting that Muslims could become the world's largest religious group by 2035 has sparked significant backlash from American right-wing figures. Despite the report noting that the Muslim population in the US will remain a small minority, critics are using the data to promote anti-immigration rhetoric and express fears about national identity. Several prominent conservative commentators and politicians have called for urgent action to preserve what they describe as America's Christian heritage.
amharic: የፒው ምርምር ማዕከል እስልምና በ2035 በዓለም ላይ ትልቁ ሃይማኖት ሊሆን እንደሚችል ያወጣው ትንበያ በአሜሪካ የቀኝ ዘመም ፖለቲከኞች እና ተንታኞች ዘንድ ተቃውሞን አስነስቷል። ጥናቱ በአሜሪካ የሚኖሩ ሙስሊሞች ቁጥር አነስተኛ ሆኖ እንደሚቀጥል ቢጠቁምም፣ አንዳንድ አካላት ይህንን መረጃ በመጠቀም ስደትን የሚቃወም ንግግሮችን እያራመዱ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ወገኖች የአሜሪካን የክርስትና እምነት መሰረት ለመጠበቅ ሲሉ ጠንካራ እርምጃዎች እንደሚያስፈልጉ በመግለጽ ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው።
oromo: Qorannoon 'Pew Research Center' baase, bara 2035tti Islaamummaan amantii addunyaa irratti hordoftoota hedduu qabu ta'uu danda'a jedhee tilmaamuun isaa, amantoota mirga qabiyyee (right-wing) Amerikaa biratti mormii guddaa kaaseera. Gabaasichi baay'inni Muslimoota Amerikaa keessatti xiqqoo ta'ee akka itti fufu ibsuus, namoonni tokko tokko ragaa kana fayyadamuun falmii godaantota mormuufi sodaa eenyummaa biyyoolessaa ibsachaa jiru. Namoonni bebbeekamoo kunneen, bu'uura amantii Kiristiyaanaa Amerikaa eeguuf tarkaanfiin hatattamaa fudhatamuu qaba jechuun yaaddoo isaanii ibsachaa jiru.

title: Trump envoys met Qatari officials in Berlin to discuss US-Iran mediation, report says
english: Representatives for Donald Trump, specifically Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, held discussions with Qatari officials in Berlin to explore potential mediation between the United States and Iran. This meeting coincided with a diplomatic visit by the Emir of Qatar to Germany, where he emphasized the necessity of lowering regional tensions. Both parties are focused on utilizing diplomatic channels to improve security and stability throughout the Middle East.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ ተወካዮች የሆኑት ስቲቭ ዊትኮፍ እና ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ስለሚደረግ ሽምግልና ለመወያየት በበርሊን ከኳታር ባለስልጣናት ጋር ተገናኝተዋል። ይህ ስብሰባ የተካሄደው የኳታሩ አሚር በጀርመን ጉብኝት ባደረጉበት ወቅት ሲሆን፣ በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት ለመቀነስ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶች አስፈላጊ መሆናቸውን አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል። ሁለቱ ወገኖች በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ አካባቢ ሰላምን እና መረጋጋትን ለማስፈን በሚቻልባቸው መንገዶች ላይ ተወያይተዋል።
oromo: Bakka buutonni Donald Trump, Steve Witkoff fi Jared Kushner, gidduu Amerikaa fi Iraanitti marii araaraa geggeessuuf jedhamee, Berlinitti hoggantoota Qatar wajjin wal arganiiru. Walgahichi kan geggeeffame yeroo Amiirri Qatar Jarmanitti daawwannaa taasisaniifi, mootummaan Qataris naannichatti waraana tasgabeessuuf carraaqqii dippilomaasii barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsee ture. Gareewwan kunneenis naannichatti nageenyaa fi tasgabbii buusuuf dhimmoota dippilomaasii irratti xiyyeeffatanii mari'ataniiru.

title: Trump says US will find out about Iranian dirty bomb plot 'rumour'
english: President Trump recently addressed reports suggesting Iran might be developing a dirty bomb, promising that the United States would investigate and prevent such an outcome. While Iranian officials have dismissed these allegations as unfounded, Trump emphasized that the U.S. remains vigilant. Additionally, he asserted that the American military maintains complete authority over the Strait of Hormuz to ensure regional security.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ኢራን የቆሻሻ ቦምብ እየሠራች ነው በሚል ስለተሰራጨው ወሬ በመናገር፣ አሜሪካ ይህንን ጉዳይ በጥብቅ እንደምትከታተልና እንደምትቆጣጠር አስታውቀዋል። የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ክሱ መሠረተ ቢስ ነው በማለት አስተባብለዋል። በተጨማሪም ትራምፕ የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል በሆርሙዝ የባህር ሰላጤ ላይ ሙሉ ቁጥጥር እንዳለው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp gabaasa Iran boombii xuraa'aa hojjechaa jirti jedhu irratti yaada kennaniin, Amerikaan dhimma kana qorattee akka dhaabdu dubbataniiru. Mootummaan Iran himata kana soba jedhee kan haale yoo ta'u, Traamp gama isaaniin humnoonni Amerikaa daandii galaana Hormuz guutummaatti to'annaa isaanii jala akka jiru mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Shenzhen was not Yalta, but Europe was definitively sidelined
english: Leaders from the United States, China, and Russia recently held their first trilateral summit in Shenzhen to discuss global affairs. While they produced a brief declaration regarding UN reform, the meeting lacked significant policy agreements or solutions to ongoing international conflicts. The event was most notable for excluding European nations, signaling a shift in global power dynamics away from traditional Western influence.
amharic: የአሜሪካ፣ የቻይና እና የሩሲያ መሪዎች በሼንዘን ከተማ ታሪካዊ የሆነ የመጀመሪያውን የሶስትዮሽ ስብሰባ አካሂደዋል። ምንም እንኳን መሪዎቹ ስለ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ማሻሻያ አጭር መግለጫ ቢያወጡም፣ በአለም አቀፍ ግጭቶች ላይ ተጨባጭ መፍትሄዎችን መፍጠር አልቻሉም። ይህ ስብሰባ የአውሮፓ ሀገራትን ሙሉ በሙሉ በማግለሉ፣ የአለም የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ ከምዕራባውያን ወደ እነዚህ ሶስት ሀገራት እየተቀየረ መሆኑን የሚያሳይ ምልክት ተደርጎ ተወስዷል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Ameerikaa, Chaayinaa fi Raashiyaa magaalaa Sheenzanitti walgahii isaanii isa jalqabaa sadan gidduutti ta'e gaggeessaniiru. Hoggantoonni kunneen waa'ee fooyya'insa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomanii irratti ibsa gabaabaa kennan malee, walitti bu'iinsa addunyaa irratti furmaata bu'a qabeessa ta'e tokkollee hin fidne. Walgahiin kun biyyoota Awurooppaa kan hin hammanne ta'uun isaa, dhiibbaan siyaasaa addunyaa garuu gara biyyoota sadan kanaatti akka jallachaa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Houthis retaliate for coalition strikes with attack on Saudi power station and port
english: Houthi forces launched targeted attacks against a Saudi power plant and a port in retaliation for recent coalition airstrikes in Yemen. The Houthi military warned that they will continue to strike Saudi energy and infrastructure facilities whenever their own territories are targeted. This escalation follows intense coalition operations across multiple Yemeni cities that reportedly resulted in significant casualties.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን የቅንጅት ኃይሎች በፈጸሙት የአየር ጥቃት ምላሽ በሳውዲ አረቢያ የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫ ጣቢያ እና ወደብ ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። የሁቲ ወታደራዊ ቃል አቀባይ እንደተናገሩት የየመን መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ጥቃት በሚሰነዘርበት ጊዜ ሁሉ በሳውዲ ኢነርጂ እና ወደቦች ላይ ተመሳሳይ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ ውጥረት የተፈጠረው የቅንጅት ኃይሎች በተለያዩ የየመን ከተሞች ባደረጉት ከፍተኛ ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎች ከተገደሉ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Humni Hutiin tarkaanfii qilleensa irraa kan koraarawwan Sa’udii Yemen irratti fudhatan wal-deebisuuf, buufata humna elektrikaa fi buufata doonii Sa’udii irratti haleellaa raawwateera. Humni Hutiin yoo lafti isaanii haleelame, iddoowwan humna elektrikaa fi buufataalee Sa’udii irratti haleellaa itti fufsiisuu akka danda’an akeekkachiiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe erga koraarawwan kunneen magaalota Yemen addaddaatti haleellaa cimaa gaggeessanii lubbuun namoota baay’ee erga darbee booda.

title: UK and EU to agree youth mobility scheme, BBC understands
english: The UK and the European Union are nearing a deal that would allow up to 100,000 young people from both sides to travel, study, and work in each other's territories annually. This youth mobility program is expected to be finalized during an upcoming summit in Brussels. While negotiations are ongoing, officials are also discussing additional agreements related to food trade, carbon emissions, and managing migration across the English Channel.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ መንግስት እና የአውሮፓ ህብረት በየአመቱ እስከ 100,000 የሚደርሱ ወጣቶች በአህጉሪቱ እና በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ተዘዋውረው እንዲማሩና እንዲሰሩ የሚያስችል ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ተቃርበዋል። ይህ የወጣቶች የጉዞ እና የስራ ልውውጥ ፕሮግራም በብራሰልስ በሚካሄድ ስብሰባ ላይ ይጸድቃል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። በውይይቱ ላይ የንግድ ህጎችን፣ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥን እና የስደተኞች ቁጥጥርን የተመለከቱ ተጨማሪ ጉዳዮች እየታዩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan UK fi Gamtaan Awurooppaa dargaggoota 100,000 ta'anif biyyoota lamaan gidduutti deemanii akka hojjetaniifi baratan hayyamuuf waliigaltee tokkorra ga'uuf qophiirra jiru. Sagantaan kun kora Bruselitti godhamurratti kan mirkanaa'u ta'a. Mareen kun qofaa osoo hin ta'in, daldala nyaataa, jijjiirama qilleensaafi dhimma godaantotaa irratti waliigalteewwan dabalataa akka godhamu abdatameera.

title: Russia targets Kyiv crossings days after Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge
english: Russia has launched a massive retaliatory missile and drone attack across Ukraine, targeting key bridges in Kyiv, energy infrastructure, and residential areas. This follows a major Ukrainian operation that damaged the strategic Crimean Bridge earlier in the week. President Zelensky reported significant casualties and widespread destruction, noting that Russia’s tactics aimed to overwhelm emergency response efforts.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ዋና ከተማ ኪየቭ የሚገኙ ድልድዮችን፣ የኃይል ማመንጫዎችን እና የመኖሪያ አካባቢዎችን ያነጣጠረ ከፍተኛ የሮኬት እና የድሮን ጥቃት አድርሳለች። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው ዩክሬን የክራይሚያን ድልድይ ከጎዳች ጥቂት ቀናት በኋላ ነው። ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ ጥቃቱ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እንዳደረሰ እና የሩሲያ ስልት የእርዳታ ሰጪዎችን ስራ ለማወክ ያለመ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Raashiyaan ganda guddittii Ukreen kan taate Kiyeem keessatti daandiiwwan ce’umsaa, bu’uuraalee misooma anniisaa fi naannolee jireenyaa irratti xiyyeeffachuun haleellaa rookeetii fi doonii cimaa gaggeessiteetti. Haleellaan kun kan hordofe, Ukreen dhiyeenya kana dildii Krimeyaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isheeti. Pirezidaanti Zeleniskiin haleellaan kun miidhaa cimaa geessisuu fi mala Raashiyaan fayyadamte tattaaffii gargaarsa hatattamaa gufachiisuuf kan yaadame ta’uu ibsaniiru.

title: Russian missile hits Poland as Ukraine's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
english: Poland reported that a Russian cruise missile and two other aerial objects entered its airspace during a massive attack on Ukraine, specifically near a location where Western allies are conducting military exercises. Prime Minister Donald Tusk described the intrusion as a deliberate provocation by Moscow rather than an accidental event. While there were no injuries or damage, NATO has condemned the incident and increased security measures in response.
amharic: ፖላንድ እንደገለጸችው በዩክሬን ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥቃት በተፈጸመበት ወቅት አንድ የሩሲያ የክሩዝ ሚሳይል እና ሁለት ሌሎች የበረራ ቁሶች የፖላንድን የአየር ክልል ጥሰዋል። የፖላንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዶናልድ ቱስክ ይህ ድርጊት በአጋጣሚ የተፈጠረ ሳይሆን ምዕራባውያን አጋሮች ወታደራዊ ልምምድ እያደረጉ ባሉበት አካባቢ ሆን ተብሎ የተደረገ ቅስቀሳ እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። ምንም እንኳን ጉዳት ባይደርስም፣ ኔቶ ድርጊቱን በጽኑ አውግዞ ምላሽ ለመስጠት ወታደራዊ ዝግጁነቱን ጨምሯል።
oromo: Poolaandi akka beeksisitetti, weerara cimaa Yukreyni irratti gaggeeffameen, misayilli Raashiyaa tokkoo fi meeshaaleen duumessa keessa balali'an biroo lama qilleensa biyyattii cabsanii seenaniiru. Ministirri Muummee Poolaandi Donald Tusk, gochi kun tasa kan uumame osoo hin taane, gareen waraana dhihaa iddoo waraana leenjisaa jiranitti ta'e jedhanii kan raawwatame fakkeessuudhaan mormii cimaa ibsaniiru. Namni miidhame ykn midhaan qabeenyaa kan hin geenyellee ta'us, gareen NATO gocha kana balaaleeffachuudhaan qophii waraana isaa guddisuuf murteesseera.

title: Nearly 600 women killed in South Africa within three months
english: Official crime data from South Africa shows that nearly 600 women were murdered between July and September. Despite a slight overall reduction in national homicide rates, gender-based violence remains a severe crisis in the country. Recent incidents, including a mass shooting in Free State province, have led to continued public outcry and government calls for better protection of women.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ የወንጀል መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት በደቡብ አፍሪካ ከሐምሌ እስከ መስከረም ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ ወደ 600 የሚጠጉ ሴቶች ተገድለዋል። በሀገሪቱ አጠቃላይ የግድያ ወንጀል መጠን ትንሽ ቅናሽ ቢታይም፣ በሴቶች ላይ የሚፈጸም ጥቃት አሁንም ከፍተኛ ሥጋት ሆኖ ቀጥሏል። በቅርቡ በነጻ ግዛት ግዛት የተፈጸመውን የጅምላ ግድያ ጨምሮ በተደጋጋሚ የሚከሰቱ አሰቃቂ ጥቃቶች ህዝቡን በማስቆጣታቸው መንግስት ለሴቶች ጥበቃ ትኩረት እንዲሰጥ እየተጠየቀ ነው።
oromo: Odeeffannoon yakka biyyattii akka mul’isutti, Afrikaa Kibbaatti ji’oota sadii keessatti dubartoonni 600 gadi ta’an ajjeefamaniiru. Hanga ajjeechaa waligalaa biyyattii keessatti hir’inni xiqqoon mul’atus, miidhaan dubartoota irra gahu rakkoo cimaa ta’ee itti fufeera. Ajjeechaawwan suukanneessaa dhiheenya kana raawwataman, kanneen akka haleellaa namoota baay’ee ajjeese tokkoo, uummata mufachiiseera; mootummaanis nageenya dubartootaaf xiyyeeffannoo akka kennu gaafatamaa jira.

title: White House removes cyber-security chief after series of tech outages
english: The U.S. government has dismissed national cyber director Sean Cairncross following a wave of technical failures that disrupted major systems like the NSA, banking services, and air traffic control. While officials deny a coordinated cyberattack, the frequent outages have sparked significant public anxiety regarding the stability of critical digital infrastructure. Kirsten Davies has been appointed to replace him as the administration works to address these growing technological security concerns.
amharic: እንደ NSA፣ የባንክ አገልግሎቶች እና የአየር ትራፊክ ቁጥጥር ባሉ ዋና ዋና የቴክኖሎጂ ስርዓቶች ላይ በተፈጠሩ ተደጋጋሚ መስተጓጎሎች ሳቢያ የአሜሪካ መንግስት ብሄራዊ የሳይበር ደህንነት ዳይሬክተሩን ሾን ካይርንክሮስን ከስራ አሰናብቷል። ምንም እንኳን ባለስልጣናት ጥቃቱ የተቀናጀ የሳይበር ጥቃት አለመሆኑን ቢገልጹም፣ ተደጋጋሚዎቹ ብልሽቶች በሀገሪቱ ዲጂታል መሠረተ ልማት ደህንነት ላይ ስጋት ፈጥረዋል። መንግስት በቴክኖሎጂ ዘርፍ የተፈጠረውን ክፍተት ለመሙላት ኪርስተን ዴቪስን በአዲሱ የሳይበር ደህንነት ዳይሬክተርነት ሾሟል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa erga sirnoota gurguddoo kanneen akka NSA, tajaajila baankii fi to'annoo tiraafika qilleensaa irratti rakkooleen teeknoolojii uumamee booda, daayreektara nageenya saaybar biyyoolessaa Shoon Kaayirnkiroos hojiirraa ari'eera. Of-eeggannoon mootummaa akka ibsetti rakkoon kun saaybar-attakii qindaa'aa ta'uu baatus, adda cituun tajaajilaa kun sodaa guddaa uummataafi nageenya bu'uuraalee teeknoolojii biyyattii irratti uumeera. Mootummaan rakkoo kana furuuf Kirsteen Deevis bakka isaatti muudeera.

title: BaddyDeadpool: The protester blending humour with activism
english: A French activist known as BaddyDeadpool is gaining attention for using dance and humor during protests. By performing in costume, he aims to reduce tension between demonstrators and police while promoting a positive atmosphere. He uses this unique approach to draw public awareness to various social and political issues, such as the situation in Palestine.
amharic: ባዲዴድፑል (BaddyDeadpool) በተባለ ስም የሚታወቅ አንድ ፈረንሳዊ አክቲቪስት በተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ላይ በመደነስ እና ቀልዶችን በመጠቀም ትኩረት ስቧል። የዚህ አክቲቪስት ዓላማ ተቃውሞዎች በሚካሄዱበት ወቅት በፖሊስ እና በሰልፈኞች መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት ማርገብ ነው። ይህን ልዩ ስልት ተጠቅሞ ስለ ፍልስጤም እና ሌሎች ማህበራዊ ጉዳዮች ላይ የሰዎችን ትኩረት ለመሳብ ይሞክራል።
oromo: BaddyDeadpool kan jedhamu duula-bultuun Faransaay tokko, hiriira mormii irratti sirbaafi qoosaa fayyadamuun xiyyeeffannaa argateera. Inni uffata addaa uffatee sirbuun, poolisootaafi hiriirtoota gidduutti walitti bu’iinsi akka hin uumamneefi tasgabbiin akka jiraatu gumaacha. Karaa kanaan, dhimmoota adda addaa, keessattuu kan Falasxiin irratti xiyyeeffannaa hawaasaa hawwachuuf tattaafata.

title: What does the ICJ’s Rohingya genocide ruling mean for Gaza?
english: The International Court of Justice has officially ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, marking a historic legal milestone. This decision establishes a crucial precedent for proving a state's intent to commit genocide, which is often the most difficult element to verify in international law. Experts believe this ruling will significantly influence how the court evaluates the ongoing case brought by South Africa regarding allegations of genocide in Gaza.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፉ ፍርድ ቤት (ICJ) ማይናማር በሮሂንጃ ህዝብ ላይ የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል እንደፈጸመች ታሪካዊ ውሳኔ አስተላልፏል። ይህ ውሳኔ አንድ መንግስት የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ለመፈጸም ያለውን ዓላማ ለማረጋገጥ የሚያስችል ወሳኝ ቅድመ ሁኔታን ይፈጥራል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት፣ ይህ ብይን ደቡብ አፍሪካ በእስራኤል ላይ በጋዛ ጉዳይ ያቀረበችውን የዘር ማጥፋት ክስ በመመልከት ሂደት ላይ ትልቅ ተጽዕኖ ይኖረዋል።
oromo: Mana murtii idil-addunyaa (ICJ) mootummaan Maaynamaar saba Rohiinjaa irratti fixii sanyii raawwachuu ishee murteesseera. Murtiin kun mootummaan tokko fixii sanyii raawwachuuf kaayyoo akka qabu mirkaneessuuf hanga ammaa rakkoo ture furuun, seera idil-addunyaa keessatti seenaa gaarii ta'eera. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, murtin kun himannaa Afrikaan Kibbaa Israa'el irratti gaazaatti fixii sanyii raawwatte jechuun dhiyeessite irratti dhiibbaa guddaa qabaata.

title: Searching for the next Messi at the Under-17 World Cup
english: The Under-17 World Cup serves as a vital platform for discovering emerging football talents who could become the next global superstars. Scouts and fans watch these matches closely to identify young players with the potential to reach the level of icons like Lionel Messi. This tournament highlights the future of the sport by showcasing the skills of the world's most promising young athletes.
amharic: የከ17 ዓመት በታች የዓለም ዋንጫ እንደ ሊዮኔል ሜሲ ያሉ ዓለም አቀፍ ኮከቦችን ሊተኩ የሚችሉ ታዳጊ ተጫዋቾችን ለማግኘት ትልቅ እድል ይፈጥራል። የእግር ኳስ አሰልጣኞች እና ደጋፊዎች የወደፊት ተስፋ ያላቸውን ወጣት ተጫዋቾች ችሎታ ለመመልከት ይህንን ውድድር በቅርበት ይከታተላሉ። ውድድሩ የአለምን የእግር ኳስ የወደፊት ተስፋዎች በማሳየት ረገድ ወሳኝ ሚና አለው።
oromo: Wodotiin kubbaa miillaa umriin isaanii waggaa 17 gadi ta'e kun, akka Liyaonel Mesii taphatoota sadarkaa addunyaatti bekamoo ta'an kanneen biroo argachuuf carraa guddaa kenna. Leenjiftoonniifi namoonni kubbaa miillaa hordofan, taphatoota dargaggoota humnaafi dandeettii qaban adda baasuuf morkii kana dhiyeenyatti hordofu. Taphoonni kunneen dhaloota haaraa kubbaa miillaa irratti mul'isuudhaan fuuldura keessatti eenyu akka ta'u beekuuf gargaara.

title: US targets Iran’s ship-to-ship transfers: Can Tehran break the blockade?
english: The United States military has expanded its naval blockade against Iran by warning that any vessels participating in ship-to-ship transfers of Iranian cargo will be subject to inspection or seizure. This measure is intended to stop Iran from bypassing oil export sanctions by transferring goods at sea. While analysts doubt Iran can militarily challenge this blockade, they warn that the move increases the risk of regional escalation and economic conflict.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል ከኢራን የሚመጡ እቃዎችን ከመርከብ ወደ መርከብ የሚያስተላልፉ ማናቸውም መርከቦች እንደሚፈተሹ ወይም እንደሚያዙ በማስታወቅ በኢራን ላይ የጣለውን የባህር ማገጃ አጠናክሯል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ኢራን በባህር ላይ እቃዎችን በማዛወር የነዳጅ ንግድ ማዕቀቦችን እንዳትጥስ ለመከላከል ነው። ባለሙያዎች ኢራን ይህንን ማገጃ በወታደራዊ ኃይል ትሰብራለች ብለው ባይጠብቁም፣ ይህ ውሳኔ የክልሉን ውጥረት ሊያባብሰው እንደሚችል ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa markaboota ergaa fi gabaa Iraan waliin walitti dhufeenya qaban to'achuuf jecha, markabni tokko markaba biraarraa meeshaa ykn boba'aa fudhatu kamiyyuu akka to'atamu ykn akka qabamu akeekkachiiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame Iraan kaffaltii fi adabbii daldala boba'aa irra jiru hambisuuf karaa markabootaa fayyadamuu ishee dhaabuufi. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, Iraan tarkaanfii kana humna waraanaan cabsuun rakkisaa ta'us, gochi kun naannichatti walitti bu'iinsa uumuu danda'a jedhanii sodaatu.

title: Newcastle United vs Arsenal: Premier League – Predictions, lineups, preview
english: Premier League leaders Arsenal will travel to St James’ Park this Saturday to face Newcastle United following the international break. While the Gunners aim to extend their five-game winning streak despite the absence of Bukayo Saka, Newcastle hopes to break a three-game winless run. Statistics favor Arsenal as the likely winners, given their current strong form at the top of the table compared to Newcastle’s position in the bottom half.
amharic: የፕሪሚየር ሊጉ መሪ አርሰናል ከአለም አቀፍ እረፍት በኋላ ቅዳሜ ዕለት በሴንት ጄምስ ፓርክ ከኒውካስል ዩናይትድ ጋር ይጋጠማሉ። አርሰናል ቡካዮ ሳካ ባይኖርም አምስት ተከታታይ ድሎችን ለማስቀጠል ሲሞክር፣ ኒውካስል ደግሞ ካለፉት ሶስት ጨዋታዎች ድል አልባ ጉዞውን ለማቆም ይንቀሳቀሳል። አርሰናል በሊጉ አናት ላይ ባለው ጠንካራ ብቃት እና በስታቲስቲክስ መረጃ መሰረት የጨዋታው ተወዳጅ ሆኗል።
oromo: Garee dura bu'aa Premier League kan ta'e Arsenal Dilbata dhufu kana St James' Parkitti Newcastle United waliin wal morkatu. Arsenal yeroo ammaa injifannoo walitti aansuun 5 galmeessisanii jiranis, Bukayo Sakaa miidhamaa waan ta'eef isa malee taphatu. Newcastle gamasaatiin taphoota sadan darban injifachuu dadhabuu isaanii booda, deebi'anii injifachuuf qophaa'aniiru. Arsenal sadarkaa duraa irratti argamuun fi qindoomina isaanii kanaan akka injifatutti tilmaamameera.

title: 'I tell my son it's just fireworks': People inside besieged Yemeni city speak to BBC
english: The Yemeni city of Taiz is currently under a tight siege by Houthi rebels, trapping up to one million people and creating a severe humanitarian crisis. Residents report a lack of essential supplies like food and medicine, while rising costs and daily violence have brought life to a standstill. Families are struggling to survive as the blockade effectively turns the city into a dangerous prison.
amharic: የየመንዋ ከተማ ታኢዝ በአሁኑ ወቅት በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ጥብቅ ከበባ ውስጥ ትገኛለች፣ ይህም እስከ አንድ ሚሊዮን የሚደርሱ ነዋሪዎችን ለከፋ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ዳርጓቸዋል። የምግብ እና የመድሃኒት እጥረት፣ የኑሮ ውድነት እና የዕለት ተዕለት ግጭቶች በከተማዋ የነበረውን እንቅስቃሴ ሙሉ በሙሉ አቁመውታል። ነዋሪዎች እንደገለጹት ከተማዋ ወደ ትልቅ እስር ቤት በመቀየሯ ለህልውናቸው መታገል ከባድ ሆኖባቸዋል።
oromo: Magaalaan Yemen, Ta'iz, amma amma kana harka warra Huutii kan jirtu yoo ta'u, namoonni miliyoona tokkoo oliis naannichatti hidhamanii rakkoo hamaa keessa jiru. Dhabamuun nyaataafi qorichaa akkasumas gatiin meeshaalee dabaluun jireenya guyyuu hawaasichaa miidhee jira. Namoonni keessa jiran akka jedhanitti, magaalaan sun akka mana hidhaa guddaatti jijjiiramtee jiraachun ishee baay'ee ulfaataa ta'eera.

title: Thousands protest Colombia’s tax plans amid row over US military role
english: Thousands of Colombians recently held nationwide protests against President de la Espriella’s proposed tax reforms and the high cost of living. Demonstrators are specifically opposing changes that would lower income tax thresholds and increase healthcare costs for citizens. Additionally, public tension is rising over government debates regarding potential military cooperation with the United States.
amharic: በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የኮሎምቢያ ዜጎች በፕሬዚዳንት ደ ላ እስፕሪየላ የታቀደው የታክስ ማሻሻያ እና የኑሮ ውድነትን በመቃወም በአገር አቀፍ ደረጃ ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የታክስ ወሰንን ዝቅ የሚያደርገውን እና የጤና አገልግሎት ክፍያን የሚጨምረውን የመንግስት ሀሳብ ይቃወማሉ። ከዚህም በላይ፣ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ሊኖር ስለሚችለው የጦር ኃይል ትብብር በሀገሪቱ ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ውዝግብ ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: Lammiileen Kolombiyaa kumaan lakkaa'aman, kaffaltii gibiraa fi gatii jireenyaa dabaluudhaan pirezidaant De la Espriella karoorsan mormuun hiriira guutuu biyyattiitti ba'aniiru. Hiriirtotni kunneen kaffaltii gibiraa irratti jijjiirama gochuufi baasii tajaajila fayyaa dabaluu mormaa jiru. Kana malees, mootummaan Kolombiyaa biyya Ameerikaa waliin walitti dhufeenya waraanaa uumuuf karoorfachuun isaa mormii fi gaaffii cimaa uumee jira.

title: Lula visits ailing Chief Raoni as Brazil recognises Indigenous land
english: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva recently visited the 94-year-old Indigenous leader Raoni Metuktire, who is currently battling cancer. During this visit, the government officially recognized the Kapot Nhinore area as the ancestral territory of the Mebengokre and Yudja peoples. This long-awaited move serves to protect the land and fulfills a significant goal for Chief Raoni, a global advocate for the Amazon rainforest.
amharic: የብራዚል ፕሬዝዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ በካንሰር ህመም እየተሰቃዩ የሚገኙትን የ94 ዓመቱን የአማዞን ተወላጆች መሪ ራኦኒ ሜቱክቲሬን በቅርቡ ጎብኝተዋል። በዚህ ጉብኝት ወቅት መንግሥት የካፖት ንሂኖሬ አካባቢን ለመበንጎክሬ እና ለዩድጃ ሕዝቦች የአባቶቻቸው መሬት እንደሆነ በይፋ እውቅና ሰጥቷል። ይህ ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲጠበቅ የነበረው ውሳኔ መሬቱን ከመጠበቅ ባለፈ የአማዞን ደንን ሲታገሉ ለኖሩት ለራኦኒ ትልቅ ግብ ያሳካ ተግባር ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin biyya Braazil Luwiiz Inaasiyoo Luulaa daa Siilvaa hoogganaa namoota naannichaa umrii 94 kan ta'an Ra'oonii Meetuuktiiree dhukkuba kaansariitiin qabamanii jiran daawwataniiru. Daawwannaa kanaan, mootummaan naannoon Kaapot Niinooree jedhamu lafa abbootii lafaa saba Meebengoookree fi Yuudjaa akka ta'e ifatti beekamtii kenneera. Tarkaanfiin kun laficha eeguuf gumaacha guddaa qabaachuu isaa fi kanneen bosona Amaazooniif falmaa turan Ra'ooniifis hawwii isanii kan guute dha.

title: Asia’s stock markets dive as Anthropic debut fails to allay AI bubble fears
english: Major Asian stock markets, including those in Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan, experienced significant declines as investors worried that the artificial intelligence industry is becoming an unsustainable bubble. Despite the high-profile public debut of the AI company Anthropic, market confidence remained low due to concerns about slowing sector growth and decreased foreign investment. This downturn highlights widespread anxiety that the massive trillions of dollars currently flowing into AI technology may lead to a market crash similar to the historical dot-com bust.
amharic: እንደ ጃፓን፣ ደቡብ ኮሪያ እና ታይዋን ያሉ የእስያ የአክሲዮን ገበያዎች፣ የአርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ (AI) ዘርፍ ዘላቂነት የሌለው አረፋ እየሆነ ነው በሚል ስጋት ከፍተኛ ውድቀት አሳይተዋል። የአንትሮፒክ (Anthropic) ኩባንያ በአክሲዮን ገበያ መጀመር የባለሀብቶችን ስጋት ማስታገስ ባለመቻሉ፣ የገበያው መውደቅ የዘርፉ ዕድገት መቀዛቀዝንና የውጭ ኢንቨስትመንት መዳከምን ያሳያል። ይህ ሁኔታ በአርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ዘርፍ ላይ እየፈሰሰ ያለው ትሪሊዮን ዶላሮች እንደ ቀድሞው የቴክኖሎጂ አረፋ ሁሉ የገበያ መፈራረስን ሊያስከትል ይችላል የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gabaan aksiyoonaa biyyoota Eshiyaa kanneen akka Jaappaan, Koriyaa Kibbaa fi Taayiwaan, indastiriin Artifishal Intelijensii (AI) gabaa of-keessa gonfatee fi itti-fufiinsa hin qabne ta'uu isaa sodaachuu irraan kan ka'e gadi bu'uu agarsiiseera. Dhaabbanni Anthropic jedhamu gabaa aksiyoonaa irratti hirmaachuun isaa shakkii qabeenyaa kanaa hir’isuu waan hin dandeenyeef, investaroonni guddina teeknoolojii kanaa irratti amantaa dhabaniiru. Kuni immoo qabeenyi tiriliyoonaan lakkaawamu damee kanaan irratti dhangala'aa jiru, akka duraan gabaa teeknoolojii guddichi itti diigame sanatti, rakkoo diinagdee cimaa uumuu danda'a jedhanii akka sodaatan taasiseera.

title: Hippo Fiona dies days after swallowing visitor’s hat
english: Fiona, a famous hippopotamus at the Cincinnati Zoo, has passed away following a tragic accident. The animal died just days after consuming a winter hat that had been dropped into her habitat by a visitor. She had previously gained global recognition for surviving as a premature birth in 2017.
amharic: በሲንሲናቲ መካነ አራዊት የምትገኘው ፊዮና የተባለችው ታዋቂ የጉማሬ ግልገል በደረሰባት አሳዛኝ አደጋ ህይወቷ አልፏል። እንስሳቷ የሞተችው አንድ ጎብኚ ወደ ቅጥሯ ውስጥ በጣለው የክረምት ኮፍያ ምክንያት ነው። ፊዮና እ.ኤ.አ በ2017 ያለጊዜዋ በመወለዷ ምክንያት በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ትኩረትን ስባ የነበረች ታዋቂ እንስሳ ነበረች።
oromo: Leencaa bishaan keessa jiraatu kan beekamtii guddaa qabduu fi 'Fiona' jedhamtu, maasii Cincinnati Zoo keessatti balaa mudateen du'uu ishee ibsameera. Fiona kan duute, daawwataan tokko gonfoo isaa iddoo isheen keessa jiraattu keessatti erga gadee darbate booda, sana liqimsitee guyyoota muraasa boodadha. Fiona bara 2017 yeroo ishee hin geenyeetti waan dhalatteef beekamtii addunyaa argattee turte.

title: Trump nominee refuses to call Jan 6 an ‘attack’ at Senate hearing
english: Michael LoSapio, Donald Trump's pick to lead the agency in charge of election security, faced scrutiny during his Senate confirmation hearing. He notably declined to label the January 6 Capitol riot as an attack. Furthermore, he avoided answering questions regarding who officially won the 2020 US presidential popular vote.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ የምርጫ ደህንነት ኤጀንሲ መሪ እጩ የሆኑት ማይክል ሎሳፒዮ፣ በሴኔት ማረጋገጫ ችሎት ላይ ጥያቄዎች ቀርበውላቸው ነበር። ጥር 6 ቀን በካፒቶል ህንጻ ላይ የተፈጸመውን ሁከት እንደ ጥቃት ለመግለጽ ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም። በተጨማሪም እ.ኤ.አ በ2020 የነበረውን የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ በህዝብ ድምጽ ያሸነፈው ማን እንደሆነ ለመናገር ተቆጥበዋል።
oromo: Mootummaa Donald Trump biraa nama filataman kan ta'an Michael LoSapio, gaaffii mirkaneeffannaa Senetii irratti qoramaniiru. Guyyaa Amajjii 6, 2021 Mana Maree Kongiresii irratti waan raawwatame 'haleellaa' jedhanii waamuun dideera. Kana malees, filannoo pireezidaantummaa Ameerikaa kan bara 2020 sagalee ummataan eenyu akka injifate ibsuun dhiisaniiru.

title: Pentagon official says US war on Iran cost $48.3B
english: A Pentagon representative informed Congress that military operations against Iran have incurred expenses totaling $48.3 billion. This financial estimate accounts for weaponry, logistical expenses, and the replacement of damaged equipment. Notably, this total excludes the additional costs required to fix American military bases in the area that were harmed starting in February.
amharic: የፔንታጎን ባለስልጣን ለአሜሪካ ኮንግረስ እንደገለፁት፣ በኢራን ላይ የተካሄደው ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ 48.3 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ወጪ ጠይቋል። ይህ የገንዘብ መጠን መሳሪያዎችን፣ የአሰራር ወጪዎችን እና የተበላሹ መሳርያዎችን ለመተካት የወጣውን ወጪ ያካትታል። ይሁን እንጂ፣ ከየካቲት ወር ወዲህ በአካባቢው የተጎዱ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ካምፖችን ለመጠገን የሚያስፈልገው ተጨማሪ ወጪ በዚህ ሪፖርት ውስጥ አልተካተተም።
oromo: Hoggansi Pentaagonii akka ibsetti, waraanni Ameerikaan Iran irratti geggeessite qarshii biliyoona 48.3 ga’u fixeera. Gatiin kun meeshaalee waraanaa, baasii hojii fi bakka meeshaalee manca’anii kanneen biroo buusuuf kan oole dha. Haa ta’u malee, gatiin kun buufataalee waraana Ameerikaa kanneen ji’a Guraandhalaatii as miidhamanii turan haaromsuuf baasii barbaachisu hin dabalatu.

title: Saudi-led coalition claims destruction of Houthi missile
english: The Saudi-led military coalition successfully intercepted a ballistic missile launched by Houthi rebels. The projectile was targeted at southern Saudi Arabia before it was destroyed by coalition forces. No further details regarding casualties or damage were reported.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ የሚመራው ጥምር ጦር በሁቲ አማፂያን የተተኮሰ ባለስቲክ ሚሳይል መትቶ ጥሏል። ሚሳይሉ የሳውዲ አረቢያን ደቡባዊ ክፍል ኢላማ አድርጎ የነበረ ቢሆንም በጥምር ጦሩ አማካኝነት በአየር ላይ ወድሟል። በክስተቱ ስለደረሰ ጉዳት ወይም የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት የተገለጸ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Waraanni Saudii durfamu tokkummaa qabu, boombii balistiiwwan kanneen finciltoota Huutii irraa dhukaafame rukutee kuseera. Xiyyarri kun gara kibba Saudii Arabiyaatti kan qajeele yoo ta'u, humnoonni waraanaanis utuu hin ga'in bakka jirutti barbadeessaniiru. Miidhaa namarra ga'e ykn gubachuu qabeenyaa ilaalchisee hanga ammaa ibsi kenname hin jiru.

title: Saudi Arabia issues more alerts
english: Saudi Arabia’s civil defense authorities recently issued and subsequently retracted safety warnings regarding potential threats in the regions of Abha, Khamis Mushait, and Jizan. These alerts were posted on social media and lifted shortly after, indicating that the immediate risks had been resolved. No specific details regarding the nature of these hazards were provided in the reports.
amharic: የሳዑዲ አረቢያ ሲቪል መከላከያ ባለስልጣናት በአብሃ፣ በኻሚስ ሙሻይት እና በጂዛን አካባቢዎች ሊከሰት ስለሚችል አደጋ ማስጠንቀቂያዎችን አስተላልፈው ነበር። እነዚህ ማስጠንቀቂያዎች በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በኩል የተለቀቁ ቢሆንም ብዙም ሳይቆይ አደጋው ማለፉ ተገልጿል። የአደጋው ምንጭ ምን እንደሆነ በግልጽ የተጠቀሰ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Abbaan taayitaa ittisa balaa Saudii Arabaa naannolee Abhaa, Khamis Mushayit fi Jizaan keessatti balaan mudachuu danda'a jechuun akeekkachiisa dabarse ture. Akeekkachiisni kun miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti erga bahee booda, balaan sun darbuu isaa ibsuun yeruma sana haqameera. Wantoota balaa kana qaqqabsiisan ilaalchisee bal'inaan ibsame homtuu hin jiru.

title: Houthis hit Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund skyscraper
english: The Houthi militia recently carried out an aerial attack on the Public Investment Fund tower in Riyadh, which is Saudi Arabia's tallest skyscraper. While the strike shattered glass and caused structural damage to the building's exterior, officials reported that no one was harmed. This incident follows a similar strike earlier this month, marking a repeated effort to target Saudi Arabia's financial infrastructure.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሪያድ በሚገኘው የሳዑዲ አረቢያ የህዝብ ኢንቨስትመንት ፈንድ ዋና መሥሪያ ቤት ላይ ጥቃት አድርሰዋል። ጥቃቱ የህንጻውን መስኮቶች በመስበር በውጫዊ ክፍሉ ላይ ጉዳት ቢያደርስም፣ በሰው ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት እንደሌለ ተገልጿል። ይህ ክስተት በዚሁ ወር መጀመሪያ ላይ በሌላ የሳዑዲ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕከል ላይ ከተፈጸመ ጥቃት ጋር ተያይዞ የአገሪቱን የኢንቨስትመንት መዳረሻነት ለመጉዳት የታለመ ተደርጎ ተወስዷል።
oromo: gareen Houtii magaala Riyaad keessatti gamoo waajjira invastimantii mootummaa Saudii irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Haleellaan kun gamoo kana irratti miidhaa qaamaa qaqqabsiiseus, namoota irratti miidhaan tokkollee hin ga'in akka jiru ibsameera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame ji'a kana keessa gamoo biraa irratti haleellaa erga raawwatamee booda yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas dhaabbilee dinagdee biyyattii miidhuu akka ta'e dubbatameera.

title: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted two drones in south
english: The Saudi-led military coalition successfully intercepted and neutralized two aerial drones. These unmanned aircraft were launched by Houthi rebels from Yemen and were heading toward the southern part of Saudi Arabia. No further damage was reported following the destruction of these hostile targets.
amharic: ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የምትመራው ጥምረት በየመን ሁቲ አማፂያን ወደ ሳዑዲ ደቡባዊ ክፍል የተላኩ ሁለት ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላኖችን (ድሮኖችን) መትቶ ጥሏል። ድሮኖቹ ግባቸው ሳይደርሱ በአየር ላይ ወድመዋል። በዚህ ድርጊት የተነሳ የደረሰ ጉዳት የለም።
oromo: Mootummaan Saudii hogganu, xiyyara nama hin feene lama kan warra Huutii Yaman irraa gara kibba Saudii Arabiatti ergaman duubatti deebisee barbadeesseera. Xiyyaroonni kunniin bakka ga'uuf osoo hin gahiin qilleensa irratti kan fashaleeffaman yoo ta'u, miidhaan gahu kamiyyuu hin jiraanne.

title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
english: European leaders met at a summit in Berlin to affirm their unified support for Ukraine and express readiness to negotiate an end to the ongoing war with Russia. While Moscow has previously excluded Europe from peace discussions, President Putin has now signaled a willingness to include them if their specific contributions can be clarified. Meanwhile, U.S. representatives believe that recent high-level talks involving President Trump, China, and Russia have made a peaceful resolution feel more achievable.
amharic: የአውሮፓ መሪዎች በበርሊን ባደረጉት ስብሰባ ለዩክሬን ያላቸውን ድጋፍ በማረጋገጥ ከሩሲያ ጋር የሚደረገውን ጦርነት በድርድር ለመቋጨት ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን ገለጹ። ሞስኮ ከዚህ ቀደም የአውሮፓ አገራትን ከሰላም ንግግሮች ውጪ አድርጋ የቆየች ቢሆንም፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ፑቲን አውሮፓውያን በንግግሩ ውስጥ ምን ሚና እንደሚጫወቱ ግልጽ ከሆነ ለመቀበል ፍቃደኛ መሆናቸውን አመልክተዋል። በአንጻሩ የአሜሪካ ዲፕሎማቶች በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ፣ በቻይና እና በሩሲያ መሪዎች መካከል የተደረገውን ውይይት ተከትሎ ዘላቂ ሰላም የመፍጠሩ እድል ሰፊ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Awurooppaa gubii Berlin irratti walgahii taasisaniin, deeggarsa isaanii kan Yookireeniif qaban mirkaneessuun waraana biyyattii keessatti adeemaa jiru mariidhaan xumuruuf qophii ta'uu ibsanii jiru. Moskoon kanaan dura biyyoota Awurooppaa marii nagaa keessaa baastee turteellee, amma garuu Pirezidaantiin Raashiyaaa Vladimir Putin hirmaannaan isaanii maal akka ta'e erga ifa ta'ee booda mariitti dabaluuf fedhii akka qaban dubbataniiru. Gama biraatiin, bakka bu'oonni Ameerikaa marii pirezidaant Traamp, Chaayinaa fi Raashiyaaa gidduutti gaggeeffame booda, nagaan bu'uun akka danda'amu abdiin qabaatanii jiru.

title: California probing whether China improperly acquired Nvidia technology
english: California's attorney general has launched an investigation into Nvidia to determine if the company misled investors regarding how China may have gained access to its advanced chip technology. The probe follows the departure of long-time CEO Jensen Huang, who stepped down amid reports of a personal relationship with a suspected Chinese intelligence operative. Officials are now examining whether Nvidia's leadership failed to prevent the improper transfer of sensitive data or hardware to China.
amharic: የካሊፎርኒያ ጠቅላይ አቃቤ ህግ፣ ቻይና የኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) ቴክኖሎጂን በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ ማግኘቷን በተመለከተ ኩባንያው ባለሀብቶችን አሳስቶ ይሆን በሚል ምርመራ ጀምሯል። ይህ ምርመራ የተካሄደው የኩባንያው የረጅም ጊዜ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ የነበሩት ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ፣ ከቻይና ሰላይ ጋር ግንኙነት ነበራቸው በሚል ወሬ ከስልጣናቸው ከለቀቁ በኋላ ነው። ባለስልጣናቱ ኩባንያው ሚስጥራዊ መረጃዎችን ወይም ቴክኖሎጂዎችን ለቻይና አሳልፎ ከመስጠት ለመከላከል በቂ ጥረት አድርጓል ወይ የሚለውን እያጣሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa mootummaa Kaalifoorniyaa, teeknoolojii kampaanii Nvidia gara Chaayinaatti karaa seeraan alaa darbe jedhamee shakkamu irratti qorannoo jalqabeera. Qorannoon kun kan dhufe, hoogganaan kampaanii Nvidia kan turan Jensen Huang hariiroo isaan ishee shakkamtuu basaastuu Chaayinaa taate tokko waliin qaban jedhamuun erga kampaanii gadi lakkisanii booda. Mootummaan kampaaniin kun odeeffannoo dhoksaa fi teeknoolojiiwwan ammayyaa gara Chaayinaatti akka hin darbine eeguu irratti hojii isaa bahateera moo miti jedhee qorachaa jira.

title: US signed off on sales of nearly 900,000 AI chips to China in six months
english: Between December 2025 and May 2026, the US government approved the export of approximately 900,000 advanced AI chips to various Chinese firms, including companies identified by the Pentagon as having military ties. This disclosure from the House Foreign Affairs Committee has sparked controversy, especially as the Trump administration faces pressure following an ethics scandal involving the former CEO of Nvidia. Critics are now questioning the security protocols used by the Commerce Department when reviewing these significant technology deals with China.
amharic: ከታህሳስ 2025 እስከ ግንቦት 2026 ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ የአሜሪካ መንግሥት ወደ 900,000 የሚጠጉ ከፍተኛ የአርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ (AI) ቺፖችን ለቻይና ኩባንያዎች እንዲላኩ ፈቃድ ሰጥቷል። ከእነዚህ ኩባንያዎች መካከል በአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ከወታደራዊ ተቋማት ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው ተብለው የተጠረጠሩ ድርጅቶች ይገኙበታል። ይህ መረጃ የወጣው የቀድሞው የኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ከቻይና ሰላይ ጋር በተያያዘ የስነ-ምግባር ችግር ውስጥ መግባታቸውን ተከትሎ ሲሆን፣ ይህም የንግድ ፈቃዶቹ ብሔራዊ ደህንነትን የጠበቁ ስለመሆናቸው ጥያቄ አስነስቷል።
oromo: Muddee 2025 hanga Caamsaa 2026 tti, mootummaan Ameerikaa meeshaalee teknoloojii 'AI' (Artificial Intelligence) guddatoo ta'an gara 900,000 ol ta'an gara Chaayinaatti ergamuuf hayyama kenneera. Manneen hojii Chaayinaa hayyama kana argatan keessaa tokko tokko dhaabbata ittisa biyya Ameerikaatiin (Pentagon) walitti dhufeenya waraanaa qabu jedhamanii kan ramadamanidha. Gabaasni kun kan ba'e qorannoo iskaandalii kornayeesi (spy) irratti xiyyeeffate booda yoo ta'u, kunis mootummaan Ameerikaa dhimma nageenya biyyaa irratti sirriitti qorannoo taasiseera moo miti jedhanii qaamoleen hedduun akka shakkan taasiseera.

title: Haiti police say at least 34 suspected gang members killed in raid
english: Haitian police recently launched a major operation in the Martissant neighborhood of Port-au-Prince, resulting in the deaths of at least 34 suspected gang members. This area has been controlled by armed groups since 2021, severely obstructing a vital transport route and displacing thousands of residents. Authorities are now focusing on reclaiming these territories to dismantle gang influence and restore safe movement across the region.
amharic: የሄይቲ ፖሊስ በፖርት ኦ-ፕሪንስ በሚገኘው ማርቲሳን ሰፈር ባደረገው መጠነ ሰፊ ኦፕሬሽን ቢያንስ 34 የቡድን አባላት የተጠረጠሩ ግለሰቦች መገደላቸውን አስታውቋል። ይህ አካባቢ ከ2021 ጀምሮ በታጣቂ ቡድኖች ቁጥጥር ስር የነበረ ሲሆን ዋና ዋና የመጓጓዣ መንገዶችን በመዝጋቱ እና ብዙ ነዋሪዎችን በማፈናቀሉ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ችግር ፈጥሮ ነበር። የፀጥታ ኃይሎቹ አሁን የቡድኖቹን የበላይነት ለማስወገድ እና አካባቢውን ሙሉ በሙሉ ወደ ቀድሞ ሁኔታው ለመመለስ እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Poolisiin Hayitii ganda Maartiisaant kan magaalaa guddoo Poor-o-Priinsitti argamu keessatti duula gaggeesseen shakkamtoota garee yakkaaf shakkaman 34 ol ajjeeseera. Naannichi kun bara 2021 irraa eegalee harka garee hidhattootaa kan ture yoo ta'u, karaan gurguddaan cufamuun isaa fi uummanni hedduun buqqa'uun isaa rakkoo guddaa uumee ture. Amma qaamoleen nageenyaa dhiibbaa gareewwan kanaa balleessanii fi naannicha to'annoo mootummaa jala deebisuuf sochii cimaa irra jiru.

title: US appeals court lets Trump end TPS deportation protections for Venezuelans
english: A U.S. appeals court has ruled that the Trump administration can proceed with ending Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Venezuelans, removing deportation safeguards for hundreds of thousands of people. This decision overrides a lower court's previous order that had blocked the policy due to humanitarian concerns regarding their safety if returned home. While legal challenges against the administration's actions are still ongoing, this ruling allows the government to stop these protections for now as part of a broader push for increased deportations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የይግባኝ ሰሚ ፍርድ ቤት የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ለቬኔዙዌላውያን ይሰጥ የነበረውን ጊዜያዊ የጥበቃ ሁኔታ (TPS) ማቋረጥ እንደሚችሉ ወስኗል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከዚህ ቀደም ተመላሾችን ለአደጋ ያጋልጣል በሚል ዝቅተኛ ፍርድ ቤት የጣለውን እገዳ የሚሽር ነው። ምንም እንኳን አስተዳደሩ በሚያካሂደው የጅምላ ስደት ላይ የሚቀርቡ ህጋዊ ክርክሮች ቢኖሩም፣ ይህ ብይን መንግስት ሂደቱ በህግ እስከሚጠናቀቅ ድረስ ጥበቃውን እንዲያቆም ስልጣን ይሰጣል።
oromo: Mana murtii ol'aanaa Ameerikaa tokko mootummaan Tiramp namoota biyya Venezuwelaaf kennamee ture sirna eegumsa yeroo (TPS) akka dhaabuu danda'u murteesseera. Murtiin kun ajaja mana murtii gadii kanaan dura namoonni kunneen gara biyya isaaniitti deebifamnaan balaaf saaxilamu jedhee eegumsa godhee ture haqee jira. Murtichi mootummaan godaantota biyyattii keessaa baasuuf karoora qabu akka raawwatu haala mijeessuuf malee, himanni seeraa karaa biraatiin dhimma kana irratti kan itti fufu ta'a.

title: Ten killed in Pakistan as bus crashes into gas tanker
english: A tragic road accident in Pakistan occurred when a passenger bus collided with a gas tanker on a coastal highway, resulting in a fire. The crash claimed the lives of ten people and left at least 27 others with injuries. Emergency responders arrived at the scene to assist the victims trapped inside the burning vehicles.
amharic: በፓኪስታን በባህር ዳርቻ አውራ ጎዳና ላይ የተሳፋሪ አውቶቡስ ከጋዝ ጫኝ መኪና ጋር በመጋጨቱ አሰቃቂ አደጋ ተከስቷል። ግጭቱን ተከትሎ በተነሳው እሳት አስር ሰዎች ህይወታቸው ሲያልፍ ቢያንስ 27 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በእሳቱ ውስጥ ተጠምደው የነበሩ ሰዎችን ለመታደግ ወደ ስፍራው ተሰማርተዋል።
oromo: Paakistaan keessatti konkolaataan imaltootaa fe'u tokko konkolaataa gaazii fe'u tokko waliin daandii qarqara galaanaarra walitti bu'uun balaan cimaan mudateera. Gombisichaan booda ibidda ka'een lubbuun namoota kudhanii yoo darbu, namoonni 27 ol ta'an miidhamaniiru. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaas namoota ibidda keessatti hafan oolchuuf gara bakka balaa sanaa deemaniiru.

title: Three arrested during Anthropic IPO protest outside Nasdaq
english: Police detained three individuals during a demonstration outside the Nasdaq exchange in New York as the AI company Anthropic began its stock market debut. The protesters were highlighting concerns regarding the environmental damage caused by AI data centers. Additionally, they raised warnings about potential financial dangers for investors if the current AI market boom collapses.
amharic: የኤአይ (AI) ኩባንያ አንትሮፒክ አክሲዮን ገበያውን በጀመረበት ወቅት በኒውዮርክ ናስዳክ ልውውጥ ውጭ በተካሄደ ተቃውሞ ሦስት ሰዎች በፖሊስ ተይዘዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ በኤአይ ዳታ ሴንተሮች ምክንያት በአካባቢ ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን ጉዳት በመቃወም ድምፃቸውን አሰምተዋል። በተጨማሪም የቴክኖሎጂው ዘርፍ በድንገት ቢቀዛቀዝ ባለሀብቶች ሊገጥማቸው የሚችለውን የገንዘብ ኪሳራ ስጋት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Kampaniin AI kan Anthropic jedhamu gabaa aksiyoonaa seenaa isaa yeroo jalqabaa erga jalqabee booda, magaalaa New Yorkitti qophii Nasdaq irratti namoonni sadadii hidhamaniiru. Hiriirtonni kunneen, buufataaleen odeeffannoo AI faalama naannoo geessisuu isaanii akkasumas gabaan AI kun yoo manca'e gatii maallaqa isaanii dhabuu akka danda'an yaadachiisuun mormii isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: US energy chief says 'things have changed' with Hormuz, but 'not visibly'
english: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright stated that oil and fuel shipments through the Strait of Hormuz have increased despite ongoing security concerns. He explained that while these supply improvements are not immediately apparent to the public, they have contributed to recent changes in energy market conditions. This clarification comes as oil prices fluctuate due to persistent reports of tanker attacks in the region.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የኢነርጂ ሚኒስትር ክሪስ ራይት እንደገለፁት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል የሚደረገው የነዳጅ እና የዘይት አቅርቦት ቢኖርም በግልጽ የማይታይ ጭማሪ አሳይቷል። ምንም እንኳን በክልሉ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከቦች ላይ ጥቃት እየደረሰ ቢሆንም፣ የሚቀርበው የነዳጅ መጠን መጨመሩ በገበያ ላይ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ መሆኑን አስረድተዋል። ይህ የኃላፊው መግለጫ በዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ላይ የሚታየውን መዋዠቅ ለማብራራት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri anniisaa Ameerikaa Kris Raayit akka ibsanitti, rakkoolee nageenyaa jiraatanis, biddiquu Hormuz keessa kan darbu boba'aa fi qulqulleeffama isaa dabaleera. Hojiin kun ifatti kan hin mul'anne ta'us, dhiyeessiin boba'aa dabaluun isaa gabaa irratti jijjiirama fidaa jiraachuu eeraniiru. Ibsi kun kan kenname, markaboota boba'aa irratti haleellaan gaggeeffamaa jiraachuu fi gatiin boba'aa gara dabaluutti adeemuu isaa wajjin wal qabatee dha.

title: Oil prices rise amid attacks on oil tankers
english: Global oil prices saw an uptick on Thursday following reports of explosions involving oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. Several vessels were reportedly damaged by naval mines, triggering market concerns about potential supply disruptions. Consequently, both Brent crude and US West Texas Intermediate saw measurable gains in their trading values.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከቦች ላይ በተሰነዘረው ጥቃት ሳቢያ የነዳጅ ዋጋ መጠነኛ ጭማሪ አሳይቷል። በመርከቦቹ ላይ በደረሰው የፈንጂ ፍንዳታ ምክንያት የአቅርቦት መስተጓጎል ሊፈጠር ይችላል የሚል ስጋት በመፈጠሩ የዘይት ዋጋ እንዲጨምር አድርጓል። በዚህም የተነሳ የአለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ምርቶች የዋጋ ጭማሪ አስመዝግበዋል።
oromo: Hormuz keessatti miidhaan dooniiwwan boba'aa fe'an irratti qaqqabe hordofee gatiin boba'aa addunyaa irratti dabaluu isaa gabaafameera. Dooniiwwan kunneen minii galaanaatiin rukutamuun isaanii gabaasuun, kunis shakkii dhiyeessii boba'aa irratti uumamee jira. Bu'aa kana hordofee gatiin boba'aa gurguddaa hundi gabaa irratti dabalee argama.

title: Confidence in Hormuz has been 'crushed' by war on Iran, IEA says
english: The International Energy Agency warns that the ongoing conflict involving Iran has severely damaged the status of the Strait of Hormuz as a dependable route for global energy shipments. IEA head Fatih Birol stated that the waterway is no longer considered secure, prompting the organization to suggest investing in costly alternative pipelines and energy sources. While finding workarounds will be expensive and challenging, these projects are essential to bypass future risks in this volatile region.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፉ የኢነርጂ ኤጀንሲ እንደገለጸው፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት በኢራን ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ለዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣነት ያለውን አስተማማኝነት አሳጥቶታል። የኤጀንሲው ኃላፊ ፋቲህ ቢሮል የባህር መስመሩ ከአሁን በኋላ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ አይደለም ብለዋል። በዚህም ሳቢያ ድርጅቱ ውድ የሆኑ አማራጭ የቧንቧ መስመሮችን እና የኢነርጂ ምንጮችን ለመገንባት መፍትሄዎችን እያቀረበ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ejensiin Inarjii Addunyaa akka ibsetti, waraanni Iran irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru karaa Hormuz akka bakka amansiisaa ta'etti itti fayyadamaa turan irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Hoji gaggeessaan ejensichaa Faatih Birol, karaaleen bishaan kanaa amansiisaa akka hin taane ibsuun, biyyoonni karaa biraa fi qabeenya inarjii haaraa irratti baasii guddaa baasanii hojjechuu akka qaban gorseera. Haala kana keessatti, karaa biraa uumachuun ulfaataa fi gatii kan gaafatu ta'us, daldala inarjii tasgabbeessuuf murteessaa dha.

title: Confidence in Hormuz has been 'crushed' by war on Iran, IEA says
english: The head of the International Energy Agency, Fatih Birol, warns that the conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran has permanently damaged global trust in the Strait of Hormuz as a secure energy transport route. To reduce dependency on this waterway, the agency suggests that countries are investing heavily in new pipeline infrastructure to bypass the area, though this will significantly increase energy costs. While these projects aim to lower reliance on the strait by 2035, the IEA notes that these alternative routes remain vulnerable to regional instability and potential attacks.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፉ የኢነርጂ ኤጀንሲ ኃላፊ ፋቲህ ቢሮል በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ጦርነት የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን እንደ አስተማማኝ የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መስመር አድርጎ የመመልከት ዓለም አቀፍ እምነት እንዲቀንስ ማድረጉን አስጠንቅቀዋል። ሀገራት በዚሁ የውኃ መስመር ላይ ያላቸውን ጥገኝነት ለመቀነስ አዳዲስ የቧንቧ መስመሮችን ለመዘርጋት ከፍተኛ ወጪ እያወጡ መሆናቸውን ኤጀንሲው ገልጿል። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ ፕሮጀክቶች በ2035 የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ላይ ያለውን ጥገኝነት ለመቀነስ የታቀዱ ቢሆንም፣ አማራጭ መስመሮችም በክልሉ ካለው አለመረጋጋት የተነሳ ለጥቃት የተጋለጡ መሆናቸውን ኤጀንሲው አመላክቷል።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata anniisaa adunyaa (IEA) Fatih Birol, waraanni Amerikaa, Israa'el fi Iran gidduu jiru amantii namoonni daandii bishaan Hormuz irratti qaban akka diige ibsaniiru. Dhiibbaa daandii kana irratti qaban hir'isuuf, biyyoonni daandiiwwan boba'aa biraa ijaaruuf baasii guddaa gochaa jiru, kunis gatii anniisaa akka dabalu beekameera. Piroojektoonni kunneen waggaa 2035 gaafa ga'u daandii Hormuz irratti hirkattummaa hir'isuuf kaayyee qabaatanis, daandiiwwan filannoo kunneenis rakkoo nageenyaa fi weeraraaf saaxilamoo akka ta'an dhaabbatichi akeekkachiiseera.

title: Houthis confirm targeting financial centre in Saudi capital
english: Houthi forces have officially announced that they launched a series of attacks against key locations in Saudi Arabia, including the financial district in Riyadh. The strikes also hit an international airport, an air base, and a major petrochemical facility in the Eastern Province. This military action marks a significant escalation in the group's ongoing campaign against targets within the country.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂ ቡድን በሳውዲ አረቢያ ዋና ከተማ ሪያድ በሚገኘው የፋይናንስ ማዕከል ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አረጋግጧል። በተጨማሪም ቡድኑ በጁባይል የሚገኘውን የፔትሮኬሚካል ኩባንያ፣ የካሊድ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ እና የካሚስ ሙሻይት የአየር ማረፊያ ኢላማ ማድረጉን አስታውቋል። ይህ ድርጊት በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጥቃት የሚያጠናክር ነው ተብሏል።
oromo: Gareen Huutii magaalaa guddittii Saudii Arabiyaa, Riyaad keessatti bakkaalee faayinaansii irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaa mirkaneesseera. Haleellaan kun bakka buufata xiyyaaraa, buufata waraanaa fi dhaabbata suusiiwwan kimiyaawaa (petrochemical) irrattis kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu ibsameera. Tarkaanfiin kun garee kanaa biyya sana irratti haleellaa geggeessaa jiru kan caalaatti jabeessu ta'uun himameera.

title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
english: The International Court of Justice has officially ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya minority during its 2017 military campaign. The court determined that the military acted with the specific intent to destroy the group, citing mass killings, sexual violence, and the forced displacement of over 700,000 people. This historic verdict marks the first time a state has been convicted of genocide by an international court.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፍ ፍርድ ቤት (ICJ) በ2017 በተካሄደው ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ወቅት ምያንማር በሮሂንጃ ሙስሊሞች ላይ የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል እንደፈጸመች ወስኗል። ፍርድ ቤቱ የምያንማር ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ቡድኑን ለማጥፋት ታቅዶ እንደተንቀሳቀሱ፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን መግደላቸውንና ከ700,000 በላይ የሚሆኑትን ከሀገር እንዲሰደዱ ማስገደዳቸውን አረጋግጧል። ይህ ታሪካዊ ፍርድ አንድ መንግስት በዓለም አቀፍ ፍርድ ቤት የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ፈጽሟል ተብሎ የተፈረደበት የመጀመሪያው አጋጣሚ ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii idil-addunyaa (ICJ) mootummaan Miyanmaar bara 2017 ergaa waraanaa geggeesseen saba Roohingiyaa irratti yakka sanyii balleessuu raawwachuu isaa murteesseera. Mana murtichaatti, waraanni Miyanmaar saba kana guutummaatti balleessuuf fedhii qabaatee akka socho'eefi, namoota kumaatamaan lakkaawaman ajjeesuun akkasumas namoota 700,000 ol ta'an biyyarraa akka godaansisan mirkaneesseera. Murtiin seena qabeessi kun, mootummaan tokko yakka sanyii balleessuu raawwachuun mana murtii idil-addunyaatti yeroo jalqabaaf itti murtaa'e dha.

title: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
english: Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping held their first-ever trilateral meeting in Shenzhen, China, to discuss global security and cooperation. The leaders issued a joint peace declaration emphasizing that nuclear war should never occur and pledged to reform the United Nations. They also agreed to boost oil supplies and criticized the overreach of international legal bodies like the International Criminal Court.

title: What the ICJ genocide ruling means for the Rohingya people
english: The International Court of Justice has issued a historic final ruling declaring that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya people. This landmark decision follows a case brought by The Gambia regarding a 2017 military offensive that forced hundreds of thousands of Rohingya to flee their homes. Alongside this finding, the court ordered reparations for the victims, marking the first time in its history that the international body has officially condemned a state for genocide.

title: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4m after row over its Nazi history
english: A rare Vincent van Gogh painting titled 'Chestnut Trees in Blossom' has sold for a record-breaking $190.4 million at a New York auction. The sale proceeded only after a last-minute settlement was reached regarding claims that the artwork had been sold under pressure during the Nazi era. Both the seller and the heirs of the original owners resolved the dispute before the auction took place.
