To maintain his influence and avoid potential legal consequences, he is accused of undermining democratic processes, spreading misinformation about Arab political parties, and escalating tensions with regional rivals. His controversial actions, including reported attempts to surveil political opponents, have led critics to describe his behavior as an attempted power grab that threatens to destabilize the country.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በምርጫ ሽንፈት ምክንያት ከስልጣን ለመውረድ ተቃርበዋል። ስልጣን ላይ ለመቆየት እና ሊያጋጥማቸው የሚችለውን የህግ ተጠያቂነት ለማምለጥ፣ ኔታንያሁ በዲሞክራሲያዊ ሂደቶች ላይ ጣልቃ በመግባት፣ በዐረብ ፖለቲከኞች ላይ ሀሰተኛ ክስ በመመስረት እና ቀጠናዊ ግጭቶችን በማባባስ ተከስሰዋል። እንደ ተቃዋሚዎች ገለፃ፣ እነዚህ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ አደገኛ ድርጊቶች አገሪቱን ወደ አለመረጋጋት የሚመራ የስልጣን ጥመኝነት ነው።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benjaamin Netiyaahuun injifannoo filannoo dhabuusaanii hordofee aangoosaanii dhabuuf jiru. Aangoo irratti turuufi seera dura dhaabbachuu akkasumas adabbii seeraa irraa ooluuf, Netiyaahuun adeemsa dimokiraasii dhiibbaa gochuufi garee siyaasaa Arabaarratti himata sobaa dhiyeessuun himatamaa jiru. Akka mormitoonni jedhanitti, gochi kun kan inni argisiisu aangoo qabachuuf jecha biyyattii gara jeequmsaatti geessuuf yaalii godhamaa jiruudha.

title: ‘It’s my friend’: Moment Trump greets Putin at China summit
english: During a meeting at the APEC summit in China, Donald Trump greeted Vladimir Putin by referring to him as his friend. The brief encounter occurred while both leaders were being welcomed by President Xi Jinping. This interaction took place alongside discussions regarding potential nuclear talks involving the United States, Russia, and China.
amharic: በቻይና በተካሄደው የኤፒክ (APEC) የመሪዎች ጉባኤ ላይ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ቭላድሚር ፑቲንን ሲገናኙ “ጓደኛዬ ነው” በማለት ሰላምታ ሰጥተዋቸዋል። ሁለቱ መሪዎች በፕሬዝዳንት ዢ ጂንፒንግ አቀባበል በተደረገላቸው ወቅት ነበር ይህ አጭር ግንኙነት የተፈጠረው። ክስተቱ በአሜሪካ፣ በሩሲያ እና በቻይና መካከል ሊደረግ ስለሚችል የኒውክሌር ድርድር ከሚነሱ ውይይቶች ጋር ተያይዞ የተከናወነ ነው።
oromo: Gubaa APEC kan Chaayinaatti gaggeeffame irratti Donald Trump Vladimir Putin yommuu nagaan gaafatan 'hiriyoota kooti' jechuun ibsan. Wal-argahiinsi kun kan ta'e yommuu geggeessitoonni lameen Pirezidaant Xi Jinping biratti simannaa argatanitti dha. Wal-argahiinsi kun marii dhimma niukileerii kan biyyoota Ameerikaa, Raashiyaa fi Chaayinaa gidduutti gaggeeffamuuf karoorfame waliin kan wal-qabate dha.

title: Could Trump, Putin and Xi end the nuclear age?
english: Leaders from the United States, Russia, and China are expected to hold a significant summit in Shenzhen, China, to discuss global nuclear disarmament. Analysts hope this meeting could revive the historical momentum once seen between Reagan and Gorbachev, who nearly agreed to eliminate nuclear weapons decades ago. By focusing on denuclearization, these global powers aim to move past previous diplomatic failures and potentially reshape international security.
amharic: የአሜሪካ፣ የሩሲያ እና የቻይና መሪዎች በቻይና ሼንዘን ከተማ የአለም አቀፍ የኑክሌር ትጥቅ መፍታትን በሚመለከት አስፈላጊ ስብሰባ ያደርጋሉ ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። ይህ ስብሰባ ከብዙ አሥርተ ዓመታት በፊት ሬገን እና ጎርባቾቭ የኑክሌር ጦር መሣሪያዎችን ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማስወገድ ተቃርበው የነበረውን የታሪክ ምዕራፍ ሊያድስ እንደሚችል ተስፋ ተጥሎበታል። እነዚህ ታላላቅ ሀገራት በኑክሌር ትጥቅ ማስፈታት ላይ በማተኮር ያለፉትን የዲፕሎማሲ ውድቀቶች በማለፍ የአለምን ደህንነት እንደገና ለመቅረጽ ይጥራሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Ameerikaa, Raashiyaa fi Chaayinaa marii dhimma hidhannoo niwukilaaraa addunyaa irratti xiyyeeffate magaalota Chaayinaa kan taate Shenzhen keessatti taa'uuf jiru. Mariin kun waggoota hedduu dura Raagan fi Gorbachev hidhannoo niwukilaaraa guutummaatti balleessuuf yaalii godhanii turan sana akka haaraatti kan deebisu ta'a jedhamee abdama. Biyyoonni gurguddoon kunneen dhimma niwukilaaraa irratti xiyyeeffachuudhaan rakkoolee dippiloomasii darban furanii nageenya addunyaa fooyyessuuf yaalii godhu.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI launches to rave reviews after 13-year wait
english: The highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI has finally been released, receiving widespread acclaim from critics who describe it as a gaming masterpiece. Developed by Rockstar Games at a cost exceeding $1 billion, the game follows two criminal protagonists through a realistic fictional version of Florida. It is expected to become the most profitable release in gaming history following record-breaking pre-order sales.
amharic: ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲጠበቅ የነበረው ግራንድ ቴፍት ኦቶ 6 (GTA 6) በይፋ የተለቀቀ ሲሆን በቪዲዮ ጨዋታ ተቺዎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ አድናቆትን አትርፏል። ከ1 ቢሊዮን ዶላር በላይ በሆነ ወጪ በሮክስታር ጌምስ የተሰራው ይህ ጨዋታ በታሪኩ እጅግ አትራፊ ይሆናል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። ጨዋታው በምናባዊ ፍሎሪዳ ግዛት ውስጥ የሚከናወኑ የወንጀል ድርጊቶችን እና የሁለት ገፀ-ባህሪያትን ታሪክ ይተርካል።
oromo: Taphi cimaa baroota dheeraaf eeggamaa ture Grand Theft Auto VI ifatti gadhiifamee jira. Tapichi gabaa irra ooluu isaa dura akka hojii nama ajaa'ibuutti guddifamee fudhatameera. Baasii doolaara biiliyoona tokko ol baasee kan hojjetame taphi kun, seenaa tapha viidiyo keessatti kan hanga ammaatti bu'aa guddaa fide ta'a jedhamee eeggama.

title: The Excuse Is the Tell in the Violence Against Amhara Civilians
english: Ethnic violence against Amhara communities in western Oromia has escalated, with regional security forces increasingly involved in direct attacks. These incidents are often preceded by political rhetoric that justifies the violence as retaliation for the actions of Amhara-based militant groups. This systemic instability is rooted in the post-1991 ethnic federalism model, which created deep divisions between native and non-native residents and fostered an environment where ethnic cleansing is frequently masked as self-defense.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኦሮሚያ በአማራ ማህበረሰብ ላይ የሚፈጸመው የዘር ጥቃት እየተባባሰ የመጣ ሲሆን፣ የክልሉ የጸጥታ ኃይሎችም በቀጥታ በግጭቶቹ ውስጥ እየተሳተፉ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች ከመፈጸማቸው በፊት በፖለቲከኞች አማካኝነት የአማራ ታጣቂዎችን ለመከላከል የተደረጉ ናቸው በሚል ሽፋን የሚሰራጩ የጥላቻ ንግግሮች ይታያሉ። ይህ አደገኛ ሁኔታ የተፈጠረው ከ1991 ዓ.ም ወዲህ ተግባራዊ የሆነው የዘር ፌዴራሊዝም አደረጃጀት ነዋሪዎችን እንደ ተወላጅ እና መጤ በመከፋፈሉ፣ እንዲሁም የዘር ማጽዳት ወንጀሎችን ራስን የመከላከል ሽፋን በመስጠት ለመደበቅ መሞከሩ ነው።
oromo: Godina Oromiyaa dhihaatti rakkoon nageenyaa fi miidhaan saba Amaaraa irra gahuu dabalaa dhufeera; kunis humnoota nageenyaa naannichaa qindoomina qabuun kan raawwatamu ta'uu ibsameera. Hojiileen kunis, gochaa garee hidhattoota Amaaraa irratti duuluu fakkeessuudhaan warreen siyaasaa maqaa 'of ittisuun' kan qindeessan ta'uun himameera. Rakkoon kun kanneen jalqabame sirna federaalizimii saba irratti hundaa'e kan bara 1991 booda diriire irraa kan maddite yoo ta'u, kunis jiraattota akka 'biyyaalessaa' fi 'alagaatti' gargar baasuun walitti bu'iinsa uumuu fi miidhaa saba irratti xiyyeeffate haguuguuf gargaareera.

title: Myanmar faces historic genocide verdict at UN court over Rohingya massacres
english: The International Court of Justice is set to deliver a landmark ruling on whether Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya people during military operations in 2017. If found guilty, it would mark the first time an international court has convicted a sovereign state of this crime. This case, initiated by The Gambia, addresses evidence of systematic violence, including mass killings and displacement, which Myanmar authorities have previously dismissed as necessary counter-terrorism measures.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፍ ፍርድ ቤት በ2017 ዓ.ም በሮሂንጋ ሕዝብ ላይ በተፈጸመው ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ምያንማር የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ፈጽማለች ወይስ አልፈጸመችም በሚለው ጉዳይ ላይ ታሪካዊ ውሳኔ ሊሰጥ ነው። ምያንማር ጥፋተኛ ሆና ከተገኘች፣ አንድ ሉዓላዊ መንግሥት በዓለም አቀፍ ፍርድ ቤት በዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ጥፋተኛ ሲባል የመጀመሪያው ይሆናል። በጋምቢያ የቀረበው ይህ ክስ፣ የጅምላ ግድያን እና የሕዝብ መፈናቀልን ጨምሮ በርካታ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶችን የሚዳኝ ሲሆን፣ የምያንማር መንግሥት በበኩሉ ድርጊቱን የአሸባሪዎችን ጥቃት ለመከላከል የተወሰደ እርምጃ እንደሆነ በመግለጽ ክሱን ውድቅ አድርጓል።
oromo: Mana murtii idil-addunyaa, waraana bara 2017 biyyattiitti saba Roohingyaa irratti raawwatameen walqabatee, miyaanmar yakka sanyii balleessuu raawwattee jirti ykn hin raawwanne jedhu irratti murtee seena qabeessa darsee jira. Miyaanmar yakka kanaan yoo himatamte, biyyi tokko mana murtii idil-addunyaatti yakka akkasii raawwachuun kan itti murteeffame yeroo jalqabaa ta'a. Gammbiyaan kan dhiyaate himatni kun, ajjeechaa faaraa fi buqqaatii saba kanaa kan xiinxalu yoo ta'u, mootummaan Miyaanmaar garuu tarkaanfichii kun garee shororkeessitoota to'achuuf kan fudhatame akka ta'e dubbatti.

title: Claude-maker Anthropic poised for more than $1.4tn stock market debut
english: The AI company Anthropic is set to go public on the Nasdaq exchange, reaching a valuation of over $1.4 trillion due to extremely high investor demand. As the first major US company focused entirely on artificial intelligence to list shares, its performance will be a key indicator of the industry's financial health. While the company expects to raise nearly $94 billion, investors remain cautious about the firm's long-term ability to turn a profit.
amharic: የአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ኩባንያው አንትሮፒክ (Anthropic) ከፍተኛ የኢንቨስተሮች ፍላጎት በመኖሩ ከ1.4 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር በላይ በሆነ ግምት በናዝዳክ ገበያ ድርሻውን ለመሸጥ ተዘጋጅቷል። ይህ በአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ላይ ብቻ ያተኮረ የመጀመሪያው ትልቅ የአሜሪካ ኩባንያ በመሆኑ፣ የዘርፉን ትርፋማነት ለመፈተሽ ወሳኝ ሆኗል። ኩባንያው ወደ 94 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚጠጋ ካፒታል ለማሰባሰብ ያቀደ ቢሆንም፣ የረጅም ጊዜ ትርፋማነቱ ላይ አንዳንድ የገበያ ተንታኞች ስጋት አላቸው።
oromo: Dhaabbanni tekinoolojii aritifishal intelejensi (AI) Anthropic jedhamu, fedhii investarootaa guddaa ta'eef gabaa aksiyoonaa Nasdaq irratti gatii biiliyoona $1.4 olitti tilmaamamee qooda isaa gurguruuf qophii xumureera. Dhaabbanni kun hojii AI irratti qofa xiyyeeffatuu kan jalqabaa waan ta'eef, milkaa'inni isaa damee kana keessatti bu'a-qabeessummaa tekinoolojiin kun qabu kan mirkaneessu ta'a. Dhaabbatichi qabeenya biiliyoona $94 ta'u walitti qabachuu kan karoorfates ta'u, gama birootiin dandeettii dhaabbatichi gara fuulduraatti bu'aa qabaachuu danda'u irratti shakkiiwwan tokko tokko ka'aa jiru.

title: Israeli military launches rare ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
english: The Israeli military has started a rare ground operation in central Gaza, moving beyond the designated Yellow Line to destroy an underground tunnel they claim threatens their troops. Residents near the Nuseirat and Bureij refugee camps were ordered to evacuate as tanks advanced and key roads were closed. Hamas has condemned this move, labeling it a serious breach of the existing ceasefire agreement.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በጋዛ ማዕከላዊ ክፍል ውስጥ በወታደሮቻቸው ላይ አደጋ ይፈጥራል ያሉትን የመሬት ውስጥ ዋሻ ለማጥፋት ብርቅዬ የሆነ የምድር ኦፕሬሽን ጀምረዋል። በኑሰይራት እና በቡሬጅ የስደተኞች ካምፕ አቅራቢያ የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች አካባቢውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ የታዘዙ ሲሆን ታንኮች ወደ ዋና ዋና መንገዶች ተጠግተዋል። ሃማስ ይህንን ድርጊት አሁን ካለው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ጋር የሚቃረን አደገኛ ጥሰት ሲል አውግዞታል።
oromo: Humnooni waraana Israa'el kutaa giddugaleessa Gaazaatti iddoo 'Yellow Line' jedhamu darbuun, iddoo itti fayyadamaa turan booda duula lafa keessaatti godhamu jalqabaniiru. Duulli kun lafarra jiru kan jedhamu yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas qileensa jala jiru kan loltoota isaanii irratti miidhaa geessisa jedhame shakkiin itti jiru diiguu dha. Jiraattonni naannoo buufata baqattoota Nuseirat fi Bureij jiran akka gadi lakkisan kan ajajaman yoo ta'u, dhaabbatni Hamaas tarkaanfii kana cabsa waliigaltee dhuka dhaabuu fi gocha balaafamaa jechuun balaaleffateera.

title: Iran war live: Saudi-led coalition strikes Yemen; ships on fire in Hormuz
english: Tensions in the Middle East have escalated as the Saudi-led coalition destroyed a missile launch site in Yemen. Simultaneously, multiple oil tankers were damaged and caught fire near the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian authorities have attributed these maritime incidents to naval mines.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ውጥረት እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ የሳውዲ ጥምረት በየመን የሚገኝ ሚሳይል ማስወንጨፊያ ጣቢያ አውድሟል። በዚሁ ጊዜ በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ አቅራቢያ በርካታ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከቦች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው በእሳት ተቃጥለዋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት እነዚህ የባህር ላይ አደጋዎች የባህር ማዕድን ፈንጂዎች ውጤት እንደሆኑ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Giddu galeessa bahaatti waldhabdeen dabalaa waan jiruuf, gareen Itoophiyaa durfamu kan Saudii waraana Yemen keessatti iddoo xiyyaaraa waraanaa balleessaniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, markaawwan boba'aa fe'an hedduun galaana Hormuz biratti miidhamanii gubataniiru. Mootummaan Iraan miidhaan kun kan ga'e miinii galaana keessaa (naval mines) irraa akka ta'e ibseera.

title: Israel uses Gaza swimming video to minimise winter hardships
english: The Israeli Foreign Ministry recently shared an Al Jazeera video showing people swimming in Gaza to argue that winter conditions in the region are not severe. This move was intended to downplay the hardships faced by residents during winter storms. In response, critics have pointed out that this single video does not represent the broader humanitarian challenges and the difficult reality documented in the area over the past few years.
amharic: የእስራኤል የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር በጋዛ የሚገኙ ሰዎች ሲዋኙ የሚያሳይ የአልጀዚራ ቪዲዮ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በማጋራት በጋዛ ያለው የክረምት ወቅት አስቸጋሪ እንዳልሆነ ለመጠቆም ሞክሯል። ይህ ድርጊት በክልሉ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች በክረምት ወራት የሚያጋጥሟቸውን ችግሮች ለማቃለል የተደረገ ጥረት ተደርጎ ተወስዷል። ይሁን እንጂ ተቺዎች ይህ ቪዲዮ በጋዛ ያለውን ትክክለኛ የሰብአዊ ሁኔታ እና የረጅም ጊዜ ችግሮች የሚገልጽ አለመሆኑን በመግለጽ ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri Dhimma Alaa Israa'el, namoonni Gaazzaa keessatti yeroo daakan viidiyoo Al-Jaziiraa irratti mul'atu fayyadamuun, haalli qilleensa gannaa naannichaa baay'ee hamaa akka hin taane ibsuuf yaaleera. Tarkaanfiin kun jiraattonni naannichaa ganna keessa rakkina isaan mudatu salphisee argisiisuuf kan yaadame ture. Haata'u malee, mormitoonni viidiyoon kun haala dhugaa fi rakkina namoota naannichaa waggoota darban keessa mudachaa jiru kan bakka bu'u miti jedhanii mormaniiru.

title: Migrant boat capsizes off Senegal, leaving at least one dead
english: A migrant boat carrying approximately 100 people capsized near the coast of Yenne, Senegal, after striking rocks overnight. Authorities have confirmed at least one fatality, with some reports suggesting two, while survivors and wreckage indicate the vessel was involved in human trafficking. This tragedy follows a separate, more deadly incident just ten days prior, prompting urgent calls for the government to investigate the rising number of maritime migrant deaths.
amharic: በምዕራብ ሴኔጋል የየን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ ወደ 100 የሚጠጉ ስደተኞችን የጫነ ጀልባ በድንጋይ በመጋጨቱ ምክንያት ሰምጧል። ባለስልጣናት ቢያንስ አንድ ሰው መሞቱን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ አደጋው የተከሰተው በሰው አዘዋዋሪዎች የተደራጀ ጉዞ መሆኑ ተነግሯል። ከዚህ አደጋ አስር ቀናት ቀደም ብሎ ሌላ ተመሳሳይ አሳዛኝ ክስተት ተከስቶ 43 ሰዎች መሞታቸውን ተከትሎ፣ መንግስት በባህር ላይ የሚደርሱትን የስደተኞች ሞት ለመከላከል እንዲመረምር ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
oromo: Dooniin baqattoota gara 100 ta'an fe'atte tokko qarqara galaana Yenne kan Senegaalitti dhagaa rukuttee hunda gaaffiin booda gad galte. Aangoonni yoo xiqqaate namni tokko lubbuun isaa darbuu mirkaneessan, gochi kun immoo seeraan ala namoota baasuu wajjin wal qabata jedhamee shakkama. Balaan kun yeroo baatii tokko dura balaa biraa namoota 43 ajjeese booda kan dhufe ta'uun, mootummaan balaa galaana irra ga'u kana irratti qorannoo akka godhu gaaffiin dhiyaateera.

title: NASA’s Voyager 1 hits record one light-day distance, 50 years after launch
english: Nearly 50 years after its 1977 launch, NASA’s Voyager 1 has reached a record distance of one light-day from Earth, approximately 26 billion kilometers away. This milestone means that communication signals now take 24 hours to travel in each direction between the probe and our planet. While some of its systems have been turned off to preserve power, the spacecraft continues to collect valuable data about interstellar space.
amharic: ናሳ የላከው ቮዬጀር 1 የተባለው የጠፈር መንኮራኩር በ1977 ከተነሳ ከ50 ዓመታት በኋላ ከመሬት አንድ የብርሃን ቀን ርቀት ላይ ደርሷል። ይህ ማለት መንኮራኩሯ ከምድር 26 ቢሊዮን ኪሎ ሜትር ርቃ የምትገኝ ሲሆን፣ መልዕክት ለመላላክ እያንዳንዳቸው 24 ሰዓታት ይፈጃል። ምንም እንኳን የባትሪ ኃይል ለመቆጠብ አንዳንድ መሣሪያዎቹ ቢጠፉም፣ መንኮራኩሯ በከዋክብት መካከል ስላለው ክፍተት ጠቃሚ መረጃዎችን መላኳን ቀጥላለች።
oromo: NASA’n qorannoo isaa Voyager 1 kan bara 1977 erge, waggaa 50 booda fageenya guyyaa tokko ifaan imalamee irra ga'eera. Kunis qorannichi lafarraa kiiloo meetira biliyoona 26 fagaatee akka jiru kan ibsu yoo ta'u, ergaa dabarsuuf ykn argachuuf sa’aatii 24 akka fudhatu agarsiisa. Humna qusachuuf meeshaaleen isaa tokko tokko kan cufaman ta’us, qorannichi bakkuma lafarraa fagaatee jiru sanatti waa'ee bakka urjota gidduu jiru odeeffannoo barbaachisaa erguusaa itti fufeera.

title: GTA 6 launches after 13-year wait, breaking pre-order records
english: The highly anticipated game Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally been released after a long 13-year hiatus. This new installment in the iconic franchise has already set impressive new records for pre-orders. Its launch is drawing significant global attention, causing many fans to take time off to play the game.
amharic: በጣም ሲጠበቅ የነበረው ግራንድ ተፍት አውቶ 6 (GTA 6) የቪዲዮ ጨዋታ የ13 ዓመት ረጅም መጠባበቅ በኋላ በይፋ ተለቋል። ይህ ተወዳጅ የጨዋታ ተከታታይ አዲስ ምዕራፍ ቀደም ብሎ በተደረጉ የቅድመ-ትዕዛዝ መጠኖች አዲስ ሪከርድ ማስመዝገብ ችሏል። የጨዋታው መውጣት በዓለም ዙሪያ ከፍተኛ ትኩረት የሳበ ሲሆን፣ ብዙ አድናቂዎች ጨዋታውን ለመጫወት ከሥራቸው ፈቃድ እንዲጠይቁ አድርጓል።
oromo: Taphi baay'ee eegamaa ture Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6) waggoota 13 booda gadhiifameera. Taphi kun gosa tapha beekamaa ta'e kana keessatti kan haarawa yoo ta'u, ergaa dursanii bituun (pre-order) riikordii haarawa galmeessiseera. Gadhiifamuun tapha kanaa addunyaa maratti xiyyeeffannoo guddaa argatee jira, kunis taphattoonni hedduu taphicha taphachuuf hojii isaanii irraa guyyaa akka fudhatan isaan taasiseera.

title: Inside the old gas pipeline where Ukraine is fighting an underground war with Russia
english: Ukrainian soldiers have been using an abandoned Soviet-era gas pipeline near Kharkiv to conduct operations and shelter from Russian forces. This narrow underground tunnel allows troops to move and fight away from the view of aerial drones, which have made surface movement extremely dangerous. By utilizing this subterranean path, the 13th Khartiia Brigade maintains a tactical advantage while staying protected from constant surveillance.
amharic: የዩክሬን ወታደሮች በካርኪቭ ክልል የሚገኝ የሶቪዬት ዘመን የነዳጅ ቧንቧ መስመርን በመጠቀም ከሩሲያ ኃይሎች ጋር በመዋጋት ላይ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ጠባብ የመሬት ውስጥ ዋሻ ወታደሮቹ በአየር ላይ ከሚበሩ ድሮኖች ተደብቀው እንዲንቀሳቀሱ እና እንዲዋጉ ያስችላቸዋል። በድሮን ጥቃት ምክንያት በላዩ ላይ መንቀሳቀስ አስቸጋሪ በሆነበት በዚህ ግንባር፣ የ13ኛው ካርቲያ ብርጌድ ወታደሮች በዚህ ዋሻ አማካኝነት ስልታዊ ጥቃቶችን እየፈጸሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Waraanni Yukireen naannoo Kharkivitti garaa lafa keessaatti ujummoo gaazii kan bara Sooviyetii fayyadamee waraana gaggeessaa jira. Ujummoon dhiphuun kun waraana Yukireen miilaan darbuu fi rooroo kellaa diinaa jalaa akka dhokatan isaan gargaara. Lafee gubbaa keessatti rooroon diinaa fi qilleensa irraa miidhaa geessisu waan heddummaateef, waraanni Yukireen bakkuma jala lafaa kanatti fayyadamee hojii waraanaa isaa itti fufaa jira.

title: 'The drones don't fly here' - BBC reports from Ukraine's new front line
english: Ukrainian and Russian forces are engaged in a unique underground conflict within a cramped Soviet-era gas pipeline in the Kharkiv region. This subterranean strategy allows troops to avoid the constant threat of aerial drones that dominate the surface, though it forces soldiers to endure harsh, confined conditions. Both armies utilize these tunnels for movement and logistics, relying on makeshift electric carts to navigate the narrow steel passages.
amharic: የዩክሬን እና የሩሲያ ወታደሮች በካርኪቭ ክልል በሚገኝ ጥበት ባለው የሶቪየት ዘመን የጋዝ ቧንቧ ውስጥ ልዩ የሆነ የመሬት ውስጥ ጦርነት እያካሄዱ ነው። ይህ ስልት ወታደሮቹ በጦር ግንባሩ ላይ በስፋት ከሚታዩት የድሮን ጥቃቶች ለመዳን ያስችላቸዋል፤ ሆኖም ወታደሮቹ በጠባብ እና አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ እንዲኖሩ ይገደዳሉ። ሁለቱም ወገኖች በቧንቧው ውስጥ በኤሌክትሪክ የሚሰሩ ትናንሽ ተሽከርካሪዎችን በመጠቀም ለወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ እና ለሎጂስቲክስ አቅርቦት ይጠቀሙበታል።
oromo: Humnooni Yukreen fi Raashiyaa naannoo Kharkiivitti ujummoo gaazii kan bara Sooviyetii kessaatti waraana gara lafa jalaa adeemsisaa jiru. Mala kana kan fayyadamaniifis samii irraa rooba rooba dhiheessan diroonotaa jalaa bahuuf yoo ta'u, kunis loltoota haala mijataa hin taane kessaatti akka socho'an dirqisiiseera. Gareeleen lamaanuu ujummoo kana keessatti meeshaalee waraanaaf gargaaran geejjibuuf konkolaataa elektirikii xixiqqoo itti fayyadamu.

title: Trump shakes hands with Putin and Xi ahead of historic talks in China
english: Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping have gathered in China for a significant summit involving the leaders of the US, Russia, and China. During the event, the leaders held initial greetings and are scheduled to participate in high-level discussions regarding global issues like the war in Ukraine, trade, and artificial intelligence. This marks the first time the three heads of state have met together in person, though officials have kept the specific agenda limited.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ፣ ቭላድሚር ፑቲን እና ሺ ጂንፒንግ በአሜሪካ፣ በሩሲያ እና በቻይና መሪዎች መካከል የሚካሄድ ጉልህ ስብሰባ ላይ ለመሳተፍ በቻይና ተገናኝተዋል። መሪዎቹ የመጀመሪያ ሰላምታ ተለዋውጠው እንደ ዩክሬን ጦርነት፣ ንግድ እና አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ባሉ ዓለም አቀፍ ጉዳዮች ላይ በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ለመነጋገር ቀጠሮ ይዘዋል። እነዚህ ሦስት መሪዎች በአካል ተገናኝተው ሲወያዩ ይህ የመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ቢሆንም፣ የውይይቱ ዝርዝር አጀንዳ በይፋ አልተገለጸም።
oromo: Doonald Traamp, Vlaadmiir Puutiin fi Shi Jiinpiing hogganoota Ameerikaa, Raashiyaa fi Chaayinaa gidduutti marii guddaa taasifamuuf Chaayinaatti wal gahaniiru. Hogganoonni kunneen wal simachuu erga raawwatanii booda, akka waraana Yuukreen, daldalaa fi teeknoolojii aritifaal inteliijansii irratti marii sadarkaa olaanaa taasisuuf karoorfataniiru. Kun hogganoonni sadan kunneen wal arganii mari'atan yeroo jalqabaa yoo ta'u, ajandaan marii isaanii garuu ifatti hin himamne.

title: William and Kate reflect on 'enduring' UK-India ties with Modi
english: The Prince and Princess of Wales concluded their three-day trip to India with a meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi to discuss the strong and long-standing partnership between the UK and India. This visit included the hosting of the Earthshot Prize in Mumbai, which highlights India's significant role in global environmental innovation. Both the royal couple and the Prime Minister expressed a mutual desire to deepen cooperation and shared prosperity between their two nations in the future.
amharic: የዌልስ ልዑል እና ልዕልት በህንድ ያደረጉትን የሶስት ቀን ጉብኝት በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲ ጋር በመገናኘት አጠናቀዋል። በውይይታቸውም በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም እና በህንድ መካከል ያለውን ዘላቂ ግንኙነት እና የወደፊት የትብብር እድሎችን መክረዋል። ልዑሉ በሙምባይ ያዘጋጁት የምድር ጥበቃ ሽልማት (Earthshot Prize) ስነ-ስርዓት በህንድ የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ፈጠራዎች ላይ ያተኮረ ሲሆን፣ ሁለቱ ወገኖች በጋራ ጥቅም ላይ የተመሰረተ ግንኙነታቸውን ይበልጥ ለማጠናከር ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Iccitiiwwan ykn angawoonni biyya Ingiliz (Prince and Princess of Wales) daawwannaa guyyaa sadii Hinditti taasisan Ministira Muummee Hindii Narendra Modii waliin mari'achuun xumuraniiru. Marii isaaniitiin walitti dhufeenya cimaa biyyoota lamaanii fi gara fuulduraatti akkamitti akka wal-gargaaran irratti xiyyeeffataniiru. Badhaasni Earthshot Prize magaalaa Mumbaayitti gaggeeffame, gumaacha Hindii kan teeknoolojii naannoo eeguu keessatti qabdu kan ibsu yoo ta'u, gama lamaanuu walitti dhufeenya diinagdee fi siyaasaa isaanii jabeeffachuuf walii galaniiru.

title: Kuwait says it repelled first Iranian attack in two months after US strikes island
english: Kuwait and Bahrain successfully intercepted drone attacks launched by Iran, marking a significant rise in regional tensions following recent US airstrikes on an Iranian missile site. While Iran claimed its target was an airbase housing American military personnel, authorities in Kuwait reported no damages or casualties. These events, combined with recent attacks on commercial tankers, have heightened concerns that the ongoing conflict involving the US, Israel, and Iran could escalate further.
amharic: ኩዌት እና ባሕሬን በኢራን የተሰነዘሩ የድሮን ጥቃቶችን በተሳካ ሁኔታ መከላከል ችለዋል። ይህ ውጥረት የተከሰተው አሜሪካ በኢራን የሚሳኤል ማስወንጨፊያ ጣቢያ ላይ ጥቃት ማድረሷን ተከትሎ ነው። ኢራን ጥቃቱን ያነጣጠረችው አሜሪካዊያን ወታደሮች ባሉበት ጣቢያ ላይ እንደሆነ ብትገልጽም፣ ኩዌት ምንም አይነት ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰ አረጋግጣለች። በንግድ መርከቦች ላይ እየደረሱ ያሉ ጥቃቶችን ጨምሮ እነዚህ ክስተቶች በቀጠናው ያለው ግጭት ወደ ትልቅ ጦርነት ሊያመራ ይችላል የሚል ስጋት ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Kuwait fi Baahreen haleellaa droomii Iraan isaan irratti banatte humna ittisa qilleensa isaaniitiin dhaabanii jiru. Haleellaan kun kan hordofe erga Ameerikaan bakka meeshaa waraanaa Iraan rukuttee booda dha. Iraan haleellaa kana kan karoorfatte buufata waraana Ameerikaan keessa jiru irratti akka ta'e dubbattuus, mootummaan Kuwait miidhaan akka hin geenye ibseera. Haleellaa kanneenii fi kanneen dooniiwwan daldalaa irratti raawwataman waliin, waldhabdeen biyyoota gidduu jiru kun gara waraana guddatti ce'uu danda'a jedhamee sodaatamaa jira.

title: Far-right influencer Jake Lang kicked out of Dearborn council meeting
english: Far-right social media personality Jake Lang was escorted out of a Dearborn City Council meeting due to his disruptive behavior. Lang, who has a documented history of making anti-Muslim remarks, falsely claimed that the Michigan city was enforcing Sharia law. Officials removed him from the venue to restore order during the public session.
amharic: የጽንፈኛ አመለካከት ያለው የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ተፅእኖ ፈጣሪ ጄክ ላንግ በዲርቦርን ከተማ ምክር ቤት ስብሰባ ላይ ረብሻ በመፍጠሩ ከስብሰባው እንዲወጣ ተደርጓል። ሙስሊሞችን የሚቃወም አቋም ያለው ላንግ፣ ከተማዋ የሸሪዓ ህግን ተግባራዊ እያደረገች ነው በሚል ውሸት ስብሰባውን ለማወክ ሞክሮ ነበር። የከተማው አስተዳደር ስብሰባው በሰላም እንዲቀጥል ለማድረግ ግለሰቡን ከቦታው አስወጥተውታል።
oromo: Namni beekamtii qabu fi yaada garmalee mirgaa qabu Jeek Laang jedhamu, walgahii mana maree magaalaa Diirbornirratti jeequmsa uumuun isaa erga himamee booda iddoo sanaa akka bahu taasifameera. Laang, namoota muslimaatiif jibba qabuun beekamu, magaalattiin seera Shari'aa hojiirra oolchaa jirti jechuun sobaan walgahicha jeequuf yaaleera. Bulchiinsi magaalaas walgahiin kun tasgabbiin akka itti fufuuf jecha, namicha achii ari'anii baasaniiru.

title: What has happened to the $18bn pledged to Trump’s Board of Peace for Gaza?
english: International donors committed $18 billion to President Trump's Board of Peace to rebuild Gaza following the 2025 ceasefire, yet reconstruction has failed to start. Despite significant funds being available, administrative delays and Israeli restrictions on supplies and personnel have left nearly 1.4 million people in temporary housing. Furthermore, recent military actions by Israel threaten to undo the fragile peace deal, raising serious concerns about the board's effectiveness.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፍ ለጋሾች እ.ኤ.አ በ2025 በተደረሰው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት መሰረት ጋዛን መልሶ ለመገንባት በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ለሚመራው የሰላም ቦርድ 18 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ቃል ገብተው ነበር። ይሁን እንጂ ስምምነቱ ከተደረገ ከአንድ ዓመት በላይ ቢሆነውም የ पुनर् ግንባታ ሥራው እስካሁን አልጀመረም። እስራኤል በእርዳታ አቅርቦት ላይ በምትጥለው ገደብ እና በቅርቡ የጀመረችው ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ምክንያት ወደ 1.4 ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ፍልስጤማውያን አሁንም በጊዜያዊ መጠለያ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Garee nageenyaa kan Preezdaant Traamp duraabuun, gargaartoonni idil-addunyaa Gaza deebisanii ijaaruuf kakuu qarshii biliyoona 18 galaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, waldhabdee waggaa tokko dura ture erga dhaabbatee as, hojiin ijaarsaa tokko illee hin jalqabamne. Mootummaan Israa'el gargaarsaafi namoota gara Gaza seenan irratti gufuu waan uumeef, namoonni miiliyoonni 1.4 ol ta'an amma iyyuu mana ijaarsa yeroo keessa jiraachaa jiru.

title: Kuwait, Bahrain face new Iran attacks after US strike on Qeshm Island
english: Tensions in the Gulf have intensified following a US military strike on Iran's Qeshm Island, prompting retaliatory Iranian attacks against Kuwait and Bahrain. Iran targeted a US-linked airbase in Kuwait and carried out multiple strikes on Bahrain, which hosts the US Navy’s 5th Fleet. Regional leaders and organizations have condemned these actions, warning that the renewed fighting threatens to broaden the ongoing conflict and further complicates stalled diplomatic efforts.
amharic: በኢራን ቂሽም ደሴት ላይ አሜሪካ ባደረሰችው ጥቃት ተከትሎ በባህረ ሰላጤው አካባቢ ያለው ውጥረት አድጓል፤ ይህም ኢራን በኩዌት እና በባህሬን ላይ የአጸፋ ጥቃት እንድትሰነዝር አድርጓታል። ኢራን በኩዌት የሚገኝ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያን እና የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል የሚገኝባትን ባህሬንን ኢላማ አድርጋለች። የክልሉ መሪዎች እነዚህን ጥቃቶች ያወገዙ ሲሆን፣ ይህ የጦርነት ዳግም መባባስ ቀጣናዊ ግጭቱን ሊያሰፋው እንደሚችል እና እየተካሄዱ ያሉትን የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቶች እንደሚያወሳስብ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Amerikaa bakkatti argamu daandii bishaanii Qeshm irratti erga weerara raawwattee booda, waldhabdeen naannoo Gulf baay'ee cimaa dhufeera. Iran tarkaanfii kana hordofee Kuwaiti fi Bahrain irratti weerara deebii kan raawwatte yoo ta'u, buufata waraana Amerikaa fi buufata doonii waraanaa Amerikaa ka biyya Bahrain jiru haleelteetti. Hoggantoonni naannichaa gocha kana balaaleffataniiru; weerarri kun waraana ammayyuu jiru kana daran akka babal'isuu fi carraaqqii nagaa jiru akka gufachiisu ibsaniiru.

title: World Bank official says Lebanon reconstruction making slow progress
english: A World Bank official recently reported that efforts to rebuild Lebanon following ongoing conflicts are moving much slower than expected. Although significant international funding was approved to clear debris and repair infrastructure, only a tiny portion has been utilized due to administrative delays and constant security threats. The Lebanese government claims that continued Israeli military occupation and active fighting are the primary obstacles preventing the reconstruction projects from moving forward effectively.
amharic: የዓለም ባንክ ከፍተኛ ኃላፊ በሊባኖስ እየተካሄደ ያለው የድህረ-ጦርነት ግንባታ ስራ ከተጠበቀው በታች እጅግ ዘገምተኛ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ለዚህ ስራ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ቢፈቀድም፣ በሀገሪቱ ባለው የጸጥታ ችግር እና የአስተዳደር መዘግየቶች ምክንያት የተወሰነ ገንዘብ ብቻ ነው ጥቅም ላይ የዋለው። የሊባኖስ መንግስት በበኩሉ፣ በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ወረራ እና በተከታታይ ጥቃቶች ምክንያት የመልሶ ግንባታ ስራዎችን በወቅቱ መጀመር እንዳልተቻለ ይገልጻል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Baankii Addunyaa akka ibsanitti, hojiin suphaa fi ijaarsaa biyya Liibaanoos keessatti adeemsifamaa jiru baay'ee suuta kan deemaa jiruudha. Deeggarsi maallaqaa gurguddaan ijaarsaaf qophaa'us, rakkoo nageenyaa fi hanqina mootummaa irraa kan ka'e hanga ammaatti maallaqni xiqqoon qofa hojiirra ooleera. Mootummaan Liibaanoos immoo, harka galchuun waraana Israa'el fi waraanni itti fufiinsa qabu hojiiwwan ijaarsaa kanaaf gufuu guddaa ta'uu hima.

title: Crowds gather as Trump arrives in China ahead of talks with Xi and Putin
english: President Donald Trump has arrived in Shenzhen, China, where he was greeted by large crowds ahead of the APEC summit. During his visit, the President is scheduled to hold critical discussions with leaders Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping. These meetings are expected to address significant global geopolitical concerns.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሼንዘን፣ ቻይና በመገኘታቸው በርካታ ሰዎች አቀባበል አድርገውላቸዋል። በጉብኝታቸው ወቅት ፕሬዝዳንቱ ከሩሲያው አቻቸው ቭላድሚር ፑቲን እና ከቻይናው ፕሬዝዳንት ዢ ጂንፒንግ ጋር ወሳኝ ውይይቶችን እንደሚያደርጉ ይጠበቃል። በነዚህ ውይይቶችም ዓለም አቀፍ የፖለቲካ ጉዳዮች ላይ እንደሚመክሩ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Pirezedaantii Doonaald Traamp gara biyya Chaayinaa magaalaa Sheenzan imaluun isaanitiin walqabatee namoonni hedduun simannaa godhaniifii jiru. Imala kana keessatti, pirezedaantichi gaggeessitoota biyyoota Raashiyaa fi Chaayinaa, Vulaadimir Puutin fi Zii Jiinpiing waliin marii cimaa ni gaggeessu jedhamee eegama. Mariin kunis dhimmoota geopolitiksii fi siyaasa biyyoolessaa irratti kan xiyyeeffatu ta'a.

title: As Trump and Xi meet, China's AI dreams face an unexpected hurdle: the Nvidia spy scandal
english: A scandal involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and an alleged Chinese intelligence operative has created new tensions ahead of meetings between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping. The controversy has intensified concerns in Washington regarding the export of advanced AI chips, leading the US to implement stricter controls on firms attempting to bypass existing technology bans. As a result, China fears these developments will push the US to further restrict their access to critical computing technology, complicating future diplomatic discussions.
amharic: የቀድሞው የኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ እና ከቻይና የስለላ ድርጅት ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው በተባሉ ግለሰብ ዙሪያ የተነሳው ቅሌት በዶናልድ ትራምፕ እና በዢ ጂንፒንግ መካከል በሚደረገው ስብሰባ ላይ ጥላውን ጥሏል። ይህ ክስተት በዋሽንግተን ያሉ ባለስልጣናት የላቁ የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት ቺፖችን ወደ ቻይና ስለ መላክ ያላቸውን ስጋት ያባባሰው ሲሆን፣ አሜሪካም የቴክኖሎጂ እቀባዎችን የሚያልፉ ኩባንያዎች ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንድትወስድ አድርጓታል። በዚህም ምክንያት ቻይና፣ አሜሪካ በወሳኝ የቴክኖሎጂ አቅርቦቶች ላይ ተጨማሪ እገዳዎችን ትጥላለች የሚል ስጋት ገብቷታል።
oromo: Hoji gaggeessaa duraanii Nvidia Jensen Huang fi namoota basaastota Chaayinaa waliin walitti hidhata qabu jedhamee shakkamu irratti kan xiyyeeffate saaxilamuun isaa, marii Donald Trump fi Xi Jinping gidduutti taasifamuuf jiru irratti dhiibbaa uumeera. Dhimmi kun mootummaan Ameerikaa teeknoolojii AI fi chipiiwwan ammayyaa Chaayinaatti ergamu irratti dhiibbaa akka guddisu taasiseera. Chaayinaan, rakkoon kun Ameerikaan teeknoolojiiwwan murteessoo ta'an irratti dhorkaa cimaa akka keessu ishee sodaachiseera.

title: Rubio says US not 'under systemic attack' after series of tech outages
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has clarified that recent nationwide technical glitches affecting banks, airlines, and major tech companies are unrelated and not the result of a cyberattack. Officials and cybersecurity experts explain that these disruptions were caused by routine system updates and outdated infrastructure rather than malicious activity. The government is working to reassure the public that there is no systemic threat to national security.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በቅርቡ በባንኮች፣ በአየር መንገዶች እና በቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች ላይ የተከሰቱት የቴክኒክ ችግሮች እርስ በርስ የተያያዙ አለመሆናቸውንና የሳይበር ጥቃት አለመሆናቸውን አረጋግጠዋል። የሳይበር ደህንነት ባለሙያዎች እና የመንግስት አካላት እንደገለጹት ችግሮቹ የቆዩ መሠረተ ልማቶችን በማሻሻል ሂደት የተፈጠሩ እንጂ በማንኛውም አካል የታቀደ ጥቃት አይደለም። መንግስት ህዝቡ ስጋት እንዳይገባበት እና አገሪቱ ከሳይበር ጥቃት ነጻ መሆኗን ለማረጋገጥ እየሰራ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoo rakkooleen teeknoolojii yeroo dhihoo kana bankoota, xiyyaaraa fi dhaabbilee teeknoolojii gurguddaa irratti mudatan wal-qabataa fi qindeeffamaa akka hin taane fi haleellaa saayibarii akka hin taane ibsaniiru. Ogeeyyiin saayibarii fi qondaalonni mootummaa akka jedhanitti, rakkooleen kun kan uumaman fooyya'iinsa sirnaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa kisaa ta'an irraa malee, haleellaa diinaa miti. Mootummaan ummanni akka hin sodaanne fi biyyattiin miidhaa saayibarii akka hin mudanne mirkaneessuuf hojjachaa jira.

title: Democrats win Alaska Senate race two weeks after midterms counting began
english: Democrat Mary Peltola has secured a Senate victory in Alaska following a lengthy vote-counting process that lasted two weeks. This win strengthens the Democratic Party's position in Congress after a contentious campaign marked by legal disputes and controversy over alleged voter confusion tactics. Peltola’s success concludes a notable election season for her party, emphasizing her commitment to addressing the urgent economic needs of Alaskan residents.
amharic: ዲሞክራቷ ሜሪ ፔልቶላ የሁለት ሳምንት ድምጽ ቆጠራን ተከትሎ በአላስካ የሴኔት ምርጫ አሸናፊ ሆነዋል። ይህ ድል በህጋዊ ክርክሮች እና በተለያዩ ውዝግቦች የታጀበውን የምርጫ ሂደት ያጠናቀቀ ሲሆን የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ በኮንግረስ ያለውን ተፅዕኖ አጠናክሮታል። ፔልቶላ በአላስካ ነዋሪዎች ላይ የተጋረጡትን የኢኮኖሚ ችግሮች ለመፍታት ቃል በመግባት አሸናፊነቷን አረጋግጣለች።
oromo: Marii Peltola kan paartii Dimokiraata taate filannoo senetii Alaska torban lama guutuu sagalee lakkaawamee booda injifatteetti. Injifannoon kun falmii seeraa fi waldhabiin kan itti baay'ate ta'us, guddina paartii Dimokiraata kan mirkaneesse dha. Peltola rakkoolee diinagdee jiraattota Alaska mudachaa jiran furuuf waadaa galuun injifannoo ishee kana galmeessiteetti.

title: India-UK ties outride Modi’s ‘decolonisation’ rhetoric
english: Despite Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s political rhetoric focused on moving beyond the country's British colonial legacy, the partnership between India and the UK continues to strengthen. The recent visit of Prince William and the Princess of Wales highlights these enduring diplomatic ties, which are supported by a new free trade agreement. Experts suggest that India can confidently address its historical past while maintaining a modern, equal, and economically beneficial relationship with Britain.
amharic: የህንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲ የሀገሪቱን የብሪቲሽ ቅኝ ግዛት ታሪክ ለማስወገድ የሚያደርጉት ጥረት ቢኖርም፣ በህንድ እና በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት እየጠነከረ ነው። የልዑል ዊሊያም እና የዌልስ ልዕልት ካትሪን የቅርብ ጊዜ ጉብኝት፣ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ጠንካራ የዲፕሎማሲ እና የንግድ ትስስር ያሳያል። ተንታኞች እንደሚናገሩት ከሆነ ህንድ ካለፈው ታሪኳ ጋር እየተታረቀች፣ ከብሪታኒያ ጋር ዘመናዊ እና በጋራ ተጠቃሚነት ላይ የተመሰረተ ግንኙነትን መቀጠል ትችላለች።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Hindii Narendra Moodiin seenaa koloneeffataa Biriiteen irraa walaba ta'uuf carraaqqii godhanis, hariiroon Hindii fi UK gidduu jiru daran jabaachaa jira. Daawwannaan illee Wiiliyam fi ishee guddittii Weels Keetiriin godhan hariiroo dippilomaasii fi daldalaa cimaa lamaan isaanii gidduu jiru kan mirkaneessudha. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, Hindii seenaa ishee darbe kabajaafi qabachaa, Biriiteen wajjin hariiroo ammayyaa fi faayidaa waloo irratti hundaa'e itti fufuu akka dandeessudha.

title: Myanmar-linked arsenic pollution prompts clean water scramble in Thailand
english: Thai authorities are rushing to supply clean water to over 20,000 households in Chiang Rai after arsenic levels in the local water supply exceeded safety limits by thirty times. This contamination has been linked to unregulated gold and rare earth mining activities occurring across the border in Myanmar. The government is currently distributing fresh water via trucks while investigating alternative water sources to protect residents from toxic runoff entering the river system.
amharic: በታይላንድ የቺያንግ ራይ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኘው የውሃ አቅርቦት ውስጥ ከደረጃው በላይ የሆነ የአርሴኒክ መርዝ በመገኘቱ ከ20,000 በላይ ቤተሰቦች ለችግር ተዳርገዋል። ይህ መርዛማ ንጥረ ነገር በጎረቤት ምያንማር በሚካሄዱ ቁጥጥር ያልተደረገባቸው የወርቅ እና የማዕድን ማውጣት ስራዎች ምክንያት የተከሰተ እንደሆነ ታውቋል። የታይላንድ መንግስት ለተጎዱ ነዋሪዎች የንፁህ ውሃ አቅርቦትን በሎሪዎች በማድረስ ላይ ሲሆን ሌሎች አማራጭ የውሃ ምንጮችንም በመፈለግ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Naannoo Chiang Rai kan biyya Taayilaanditti, bishaan dhugaatii keessatti summiin 'arseniik' jedhamu daangaa eegumsa fayyaa irra darbee waan argameef, maatiiwwan 20,000 ol ta'an rakkinaaf saaxilamaniiru. Balaan kun kan uumame hojiiwwan qonnaan ykn albuuda baasuu kan biyya Myaanmaaritti seeraan ala geggeeffamaa jiran irraa akka ta'e mirkanaa'eera. Mootummaan Taayilaand jiraattotaaf bishaan qulqulluu konkolaataan dhiyeessaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, furmaata waaraa argachuufis qorannoo geggeessaa jira.

title: Paris Hilton and AOC speak against AI-generated deepfakes
english: Paris Hilton and Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez have joined forces to condemn the creation of AI-generated deepfakes that specifically target women and young girls. They are calling for urgent action on the Defiance Act, a piece of legislation passed by the US Senate months ago that has yet to be implemented. The duo is pushing for these protections to be enforced to prevent further digital harassment and exploitation.
amharic: ፓሪስ ሂልተን እና የኮንግረስ አባል አሌክሳንድሪያ ኦካሲዮ-ኮርቴዝ ሴቶችን እና ወጣት ልጃገረዶችን ዒላማ ያደረጉ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ (AI) የተፈጠሩ የውሸት ምስሎችን እና ቪዲዮዎችን በአንድነት ተቃውመዋል። ከወራት በፊት በአሜሪካ ሴኔት የፀደቀው ነገር ግን እስካሁን ተግባራዊ ያልሆነውን 'Defiance Act' ህግ እንዲተገበር እየወተወቱ ነው። ሁለቱ ታዋቂ ሰዎች ዲጂታል ትንኮሳን እና ብዝበዛን ለመከላከል የህግ ከለላዎች በአስቸኳይ እንዲሰሩ ግፊት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Paaris Hiiltan fi miseensi Koongirasii Aleksaandiriyaa Ookaasiyoo-Korteez sagalee isaanii tokko taasisuun, fayyadamtoota seeraan ala AI fayyadamuun suuraa ykn viidiyoo sobaa dubartoota fi shamarran irratti hojjetamu balaaleeffataniiru. Isaanis seera 'Defiance Act' jedhamu kan ji'oota hedduu dura Mana Maree Senetii Ameerikaa keessatti darbe garuu hanga ammaa hojiirra hin oolle akka ariitiidhaan hojiirra oolu gaafataniiru. Namoonni kunneen miidhaa fi balleessee miidiyaa hawaasaa keessatti raawwatamu ittisuuf seera kana akka cimsuu qaban itti fayyadamtootaa fi qaama dhimmi ilaalu gorsaniiru.

title: Venezuelan boxer Linares arrested in US and faces deportation, ICE confirms
english: Former Venezuelan boxing world champion Jorge Linares is currently in custody after being detained by U.S. immigration authorities at the El Paso International Airport. While officials state he is being held for deportation due to a lack of legal immigration status, his legal team maintains that he is authorized to be in the country. His lawyers are working with authorities to resolve the situation, while the boxer remains at a processing center in Texas.
amharic: የቀድሞው የቬንዙዌላ የዓለም ቦክስ ሻምፒዮን ጆርጅ ሊናሬስ በኤል ፓሶ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በአሜሪካ የኢሚግሬሽን ባለስልጣናት ተይዞ በእስር ላይ ይገኛል። ባለስልጣናቱ አትሌቱ ህጋዊ የመኖሪያ ፍቃድ ባለመኖሩ ምክንያት ለስደት ሂደት እንደተያዘ ቢገልጹም፣ ጠበቆቹ ግን በአሜሪካ የመቆየት ህጋዊ ፈቃድ እንዳለው ይከራከራሉ። የህግ ባለሙያዎቹ ጉዳዩን በአፋጣኝ ለመፍታት ከሚመለከታቸው አካላት ጋር እየሰሩ ሲሆን፣ ቦክሰኛው በአሁኑ ጊዜ በቴክሳስ በሚገኝ ማቆያ ጣቢያ ይገኛል።
oromo: Leenjiisaan boorsii addunyaa kan duraanii kan ta'e Jorge Linares, buufata xiyyaaraa El Paso keessatti aangotni immigreeshinii Amerikaatiin qabamee hidhaatti darbeera. Aangotni kun akka jedhanitti, Linares kan qabame ulaagaa seeraa biyyattii waan hin guunneef gara biyyatti deebisuuf yaadamee akka ta'e ibsanis, gorsitootni seeraa isaa garuu inni biyyattii keessa jiraachuuf heeyyama akka qabu dubbatu. Gareen seeraa isaa dhimma kana ariitiin furuuf aangota wajjin hojjechaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, inni garuu yeroof buufata qabii keessatti argama.

title: ‘We want to go back’: Rohingya refugees pin hopes on ICJ genocide verdict
english: Rohingya refugees living in Bangladesh are waiting for a landmark International Court of Justice ruling regarding genocide allegations against Myanmar. Families who fled the 2017 military crackdown hope that a favorable verdict will validate their suffering and support their desire to return home. Despite their optimism, many remain uncertain about whether a legal victory will lead to immediate improvements in their living conditions or a safe path back to Myanmar.
amharic: በባንግላዲሽ የሚገኙ የሮሂንጋ ስደተኞች በማያንማር ላይ በቀረበው የዘር ማጥፋት ክስ ዓለም አቀፉ የፍትህ ፍርድ ቤት የሚሰጠውን ውሳኔ በጉጉት እየጠበቁ ነው። በ2017 ከወታደራዊ ጥቃት የተረፉት እነዚህ ስደተኞች፣ የፍርድ ቤቱ ውሳኔ ለደረሰባቸው መከራ እውቅና በመስጠት ወደ ሀገራቸው ለመመለስ የሚደረገውን ጥረት እንደሚያግዝ ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ። ሆኖም የህግ ድል ቢገኝም፣ በኑሯቸው ላይ ፈጣን ለውጥ ያመጣል ወይስ ወደ ሀገራቸው የመመለስ ዕድል ይፈጥራል የሚለው አሁንም አጠያያቂ ነው።
oromo: Baangilaadhesh keessatti kan argaman baqattoonni Rohinjiyaa himata sanyii balleessuu Maayaanmaar irratti dhiyaate ilaalchisee murtii Mana Murtii Addunyaa eeggachaa jiru. Namoonni bara 2017 haleellaa waraanaa irraa baqatan kun, murtii tolaa ta'e tokko rakkoo isaan irra ga'eef beekamtii kennee gara biyya isaaniitti deebi'uuf akka isaan gargaaru abdii qabu. Ta'us, injifannoon seeraa kun jireenya isaanii irratti jijjiirama hatattamaa fida ykn gara biyyaatti deebi'uuf karaa mijataa uuma jedhamee hin eegamu.

title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as firm reports bumper results
english: Nvidia reported a massive financial success, with sales and profits doubling to reach record levels despite the recent departure of co-founder Jensen Huang. The company's leadership confirmed they have no intention of bringing Huang back, emphasizing that operations remain stable and growth will continue. While some analysts worry about future strategic direction, the company's strong performance has eased immediate concerns regarding the tech firm's momentum.
amharic: ኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) መስራች ጄንሰን ሁአንግ ከኩባንያው ቢለቁም፣ የገቢ እና የትርፍ መጠኑ በእጥፍ በማደግ ታሪካዊ ውጤት ማስመዝገቡን አስታውቋል። የኩባንያው አመራሮች ሁአንግን ወደ ስልጣን ለመመለስ ምንም አይነት እቅድ እንደሌላቸው እና ስራው በተለመደው ሁኔታ እንደሚቀጥል አረጋግጠዋል። ምንም እንኳን አንዳንድ ተንታኞች ስለወደፊት ስትራቴጂካዊ ውሳኔዎች ስጋት ቢኖራቸውም፣ ኩባንያው ያስመዘገበው ጠንካራ የፋይናንስ ውጤት የገበያ ተስፋዎችን አድሶታል።
oromo: Nvidia bu'aa gabaa guddaa galmeessiseera; haa ta'u malee, dhaabbata kana kan hundeesse Jensen Huang gadi lakkisuun isaa ni yaadatama. Bulchiinsi dhaabbatichaa akka ibsetti, Huang deebisanii dhaabuuf karoorri tokkollee akka hin jirre fi hojiin isaanii haala gaariin itti fufaa akka jiru mirkaneessaniiru. Namoonni gabaa xiinxalan tokko tokko gara fuulduraatti tarsiimoo dhaabbatichaa ilaalchisee yaaddoo qabaatanis, bu'aan isaanii inni quubsaan yaaddoo kana furuun guddina isaanii agarsiiseera.

title: Thomas Markle charged over child sex abuse material in Philippines
english: Thomas Markle, the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, is facing new criminal charges in the Philippines for possessing and intending to distribute child sexual abuse material. This follows his recent arrest in the United States, where authorities seized evidence from his storage units. Markle, who is currently in U.S. custody, has denied these serious allegations while remaining estranged from his daughter.
amharic: የሜጋን ማርክል አባት የሆኑት ቶማስ ማርክል፣ ህገ-ወጥ የህጻናት የወሲብ ምስሎችን በመያዝ እና ለማሰራጨት በማቀድ በፊሊፒንስ ክስ ተመሰረተባቸው። ይህ ክስ የተመሰረተው በቅርቡ በአሜሪካ ከተያዙ በኋላ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት ከእሳቸው መጋዘኖች ተያያዥ ማስረጃዎችን አግኝተዋል። በአሁኑ ጊዜ በአሜሪካ እስር ላይ የሚገኙት ቶማስ ማርክል የተከሰሱባቸውን ድርጊቶች αρነውታል፤ ከልጃቸው ሜጋንም ጋር ያላቸው ግንኙነት የተቋረጠ መሆኑ ይታወቃል።
oromo: Abbaan Meghan Markle kan ta'an Thomas Markle, biyya Filippiins keessatti qabiyyee saal-qunnamtii daa'immanii kan seeraan alaa qabatanii argamuufi raabsudhaaf karooruun himatamaniiru. Himannaan kun kan dhufu, yeroo ammaa kana Ameerikaa keessatti qabamanii erga himatamanii booda yoo ta'u, qorattoonni mana kuusaa isaanii keessaa ragaa tokko tokko argachuu isaanii ibsameera. Thomas Markle yeroo ammaa Ameerikaatti hidhamanii kan jiran yoo ta'u, himannaa kana kan haalan yoo ta'u, mucaa isaanii wajjinis walitti dhufeenyi isaanii kan addaan citeedha.

title: 'It was really scary': Mother describes sheltering during Russia strikes on Kyiv bridge
english: Russian missile strikes hit major bridges in Kyiv late Monday, causing significant structural damage and forcing the closure of the Northern bridge. Residents living nearby, including a mother named Masha, described the terrifying explosions that forced them to seek immediate shelter. Emergency crews are currently assessing the damage, though the attacks have caused widespread travel disruptions across the city.
amharic: የሩሲያ ሚሳኤሎች ሰኞ ምሽት በኪየቭ ዋና ዋና ድልድዮች ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘራቸው ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶ ድልድዮቹ እንዲዘጉ ተደርገዋል። ማሻ የተባለች እናት እና ቤተሰቧን ጨምሮ በአካባቢው የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች፣ የፍንዳታው ድምፅ እጅግ አስፈሪ እንደነበር እና ለመጠለል መገደዳቸውን ገልጸዋል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በቦታው ላይ ጉዳቱን እየገመገሙ ቢሆንም፣ ጥቃቱ በከተማዋ የመንገድ ትራፊክ ላይ ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Halkan Wiixata darbe, boombiin Ruusiyaa daandiiwwan gurguddoo magaalaa Kiyyivitti argaman rukutuun miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Miidhaa kanaan walqabatee, daandiin ‘Northern bridge’ jedhamu akka cufamu ta’eera. Jiraattonni naannichaa, kanneen akka haadha mana tokkoo Maashaa, sagaleen dhukaatii sun akka malee sodaachisaa akka turee fi bakka dhokatan barbaaduuf akka dirqaman dubbataniiru. Hojjettoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa miidhaa sana qorachaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, haleellaan kun imala magaalaa keessaa irratti gufuu guddaa uumee jira.

title: What is Trump hoping to achieve at APEC meeting in China?
english: President Donald Trump is attending the APEC summit in China to hold discussions with Chinese President Xi Jinping and potentially Russian President Vladimir Putin. While this marks their third meeting this year, experts anticipate the talks will remain largely symbolic rather than resulting in major policy breakthroughs regarding trade, AI, or Taiwan. These diplomatic efforts occur as Trump faces increased political pressure domestically following recent losses in the US Congress.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቻይና በሚካሄደው የኤፔክ (APEC) ጉባኤ ላይ ለመሳተፍ እና ከቻይናው ፕሬዝዳንት ዢ ጂንፒንግ እንዲሁም ምናልባትም ከሩሲያው ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን ጋር ለመወያየት ዝግጅት አድርገዋል። የዘንድሮው ሦስተኛው ስብሰባ ቢሆንም፣ በንግድ፣ በአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ እና በታይዋን ጉዳዮች ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ የሚያመጣ ስምምነት ይኖራል ተብሎ አይጠበቅም። ይህ ጉባኤ በትራምፕ ላይ በአሜሪካ ኮንግረስ በደረሰው ሽንፈት ሳቢያ የውስጥ ፖለቲካዊ ጫና ባለበት ወቅት የሚካሄድ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaanald Traamp gubaa'ii APEC kan Chaayinaatti taasifamu irratti hirmaachuun, pireezidaantii Chaayinaa Sii Jiinpiingii fi tarii pireezidaantii Raashiyaa Vilaadimiir Puutiin waliin mari'achuuf karoorfataniiru. Kun wal arguun isaanii kan sadaffaa ta'us, dhimmoota daldalaa, teknooloojii fi Taayiwaan irratti bu'aa qabatamaa ta'e tokko ni argamsiisa jedhamee hin eeggamu. Mariin kun kan gaggeeffamu Traamp filannoo biyyoolessaa Ameerikaa booda dhiibbaa siyaasaa keessoo irratti uumamee jiru keessatti dha.

title: Prosecutors allege man ‘destroyed’ US military plane at Irish airport
english: A 48-year-old Irish man, Daithi O’Corrain, has been indicted for causing severe damage to a US military C-130 aircraft at Shannon Airport. Prosecutors claim he used an axe and other tools to sabotage the plane as an act of protest against US foreign policy in the Middle East. The aircraft, valued at $60 million, was left inoperable, and the suspect now faces potential federal charges in New York that could result in a 10-year prison sentence.
amharic: ዳይቲ ኦኮሬን የተባለ የ48 ዓመት የቆጵሮስ ተወላጅ፣ በአየርላንድ ሻነን አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ የቆመ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ አውሮፕላን ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት በማድረስ ተከሰሰ። ግለሰቡ በአሜሪካ የመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ፖሊሲ ላይ ተቃውሞውን ለመግለጽ መጥረቢያ በመጠቀም አውሮፕላኑን አበላሽቷል። 60 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመተው ይህ አውሮፕላን ጥቅም ላይ የማይውል ሲሆን፣ ተጠርጣሪው በኒውዮርክ በፍርድ ቤት ቢቀርብ እስከ 10 ዓመት የሚደርስ እስራት ሊቀጣ ይችላል።
oromo: Namni umriin isaa 48 ta'e Daithi O’Corrain jedhamu, buufata xiyyaaraa Shannonitti xiyyaara waraana Amerikaa C-130 irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera jedhamee himatameera. Namichi kun siyaasa Amerikaa kan Baha Giddu-galeessaa mormuuf jecha, qottoo fi meeshaalee biroo fayyadamuun xiyyaaricha mancaasuu isaa qorattoonni ibsaniiru. Xiyyaarri doolaara miiliyoona 60 baasu kun guutummaatti kan barbadaa'e yoo ta'u, shakkamichi yoo yakka kanaan irratti mirkanaa'e waggaa 10 hamma ta'u hidhamuu danda'a.

title: Man charged over ‘brutal attack’ on Somali-American in Minnesota
english: A 25-year-old man named Samit Apurva Patel has been charged with attempted murder and carjacking following a violent attack on a Somali-American Uber driver in Minnesota. The victim, Mohamed Yusuf, remains in critical condition after being strangled and run over by his own vehicle. While the victim’s family suspects the assault was motivated by hate, prosecutors stated they currently lack sufficient evidence to file hate crime charges.
amharic: ሳሚት አፑርቫ ፓቴል የተባለ የ25 ዓመት ወጣት በሚኒሶታ የሶማሌ አሜሪካዊ የሆነ የኡበር ሹፌር ላይ በፈጸመው አሰቃቂ ጥቃት በግድያ ሙከራ እና በመኪና ዘረፋ ተከሷል። ተጎጂው መሐመድ ዩሱፍ በታነቀበት እና በራሱ መኪና በተገጨበት ወቅት ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶበት በአስጊ ሁኔታ ላይ ይገኛል። የቤተሰቡ አባላት ጥቃቱ በዘረኝነት የተፈጸመ እንደሆነ ቢጠረጥሩም፣ አቃቤ ህግ እስካሁን ድረስ ይህንን የሚያረጋግጥ በቂ ማስረጃ የለም ብለዋል።
oromo: Namni umriin isaa waggaa 25 ta'e, Saamit Apurvaa Paatel jedhamu, miinisootaatti konkolaataa Uber kan oofu lammii Ameerikaa kan ta'e Soomaaliyaa tokko irratti miidhaa hamaa waan geessiseef, yaalii ajjeechaa fi saaminsa konkolaataatiin himatameera. Miidhamtuun, Mohaammad Yuusuf, harkisamee fi konkolaataa isaa mataa isaatiin waan irra darbameef, haala hamaa keessa jira. Maatiin isaa haleellaan kun jibbaa irratti hundaa'ee kan raawwatame ta'uu shakkanis, abbaan alangaa himata yakka jibbaa banuuf ragaan ga'aan hin jiru jedhaniiru.

title: Protests as Jason Arday’s accuser speaks at Oxford University
english: Hundreds of protesters gathered at Oxford University to demonstrate against American academic Nathan Cofnas during his appearance at a student event. Cofnas has been widely criticized for accusing the late Cambridge professor Jason Arday of plagiarism. Many activists believe his public campaign against Arday was a targeted harassment effort that negatively impacted the professor before his passing.
amharic: በኦክስፎርድ ዩኒቨርሲቲ በተካሄደ ዝግጅት ላይ አሜሪካዊው ምሁር ናታን ኮፍናስ ንግግር ለማድረግ በመገኘታቸው በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተቃዋሚዎች ተቃውሟቸውን ገልጸዋል። ኮፍናስ የቀድሞውን የካምብሪጅ ፕሮፌሰር ጄሰን አርዳይን በምርምር ስርቆት በመክሰሳቸው ከፍተኛ ትችት ሲሰነዘርባቸው ቆይተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ በፕሮፌሰር አርዳይ ላይ የተደረገው ይህ ዘመቻ ግለሰቡ ከመሞታቸው በፊት ለደረሰባቸው ጉዳት አስተዋጽኦ ያደረገ አድሎአዊ ድርጊት ነው ብለው ያምናሉ።
oromo: Yuunivarsitii Oksfoordiitti hayyuu Ameerikaa Naataan Kofnaas sirna tokko irratti argamuu isaatiin wal-qabatee namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman mormii dhageessisaniiru. Kofnaas piroofeesara kaambrijii kan ta'an Jeeson Arday irratti himata hatuu qorannoo dhiyeessuudhaan komatamaa turaniiru. Mormitootni akka jedhanitti, Kofnaas piroofeesaricha irratti duula gaggeessaa turee fi kunis du'a isaanii dura miidhaa cimaa akka isaan irra ga'u sababa ta'eera.

title: Board of Peace warns Gaza ceasefire faces imminent collapse without action
english: The US-supported Board of Peace has alerted the UN Security Council that the 2025 ceasefire in Gaza is nearing failure due to persistent fighting and delays in fulfilling agreement terms. The board highlighted that ongoing Israeli military strikes and significant obstacles to delivering humanitarian aid are worsening the living conditions for displaced Palestinians. Without urgent corrective measures to bridge the gap between promises and reality, officials warn that the fragile truce will likely fall apart.
amharic: በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የሚንቀሳቀሰው የሰላም ቦርድ እ.ኤ.አ በ2025 የተደረገው የጋዛ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት፣ ቀጣይነት ባለው ግጭት እና በስምምነቱ ውሎች አፈጻጸም መጓተት ምክንያት የመፍረስ አደጋ እንደተጋረጠበት ለተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት አስታውቋል። ቦርዱ በእስራኤል በኩል የሚደረጉ የአየር ጥቃቶች እና ለሰብአዊ ዕርዳታ መግቢያ የተቀመጡ ገደቦች በጋዛ የሚገኙ ተፈናቃዮችን ህይወት እጅግ አስቸጋሪ እንዳደረገው ገልጿል። በስምምነቱ እና በተግባራዊ እንቅስቃሴው መካከል ያለውን ክፍተት ለመሙላት ፈጣን እርምጃ ካልተወሰደ፣ ተሰባሪው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ሊቀለበስ እንደሚችል ማስጠንቀቂያ ተሰጥቷል።
oromo: Boordiin Nageenyaa kan US deeggaramu, walii galteen dhaabbii waraanaa bara 2025 Gaazaa keessatti mallatteeffame, waraanni itti fufuu fi waliigaltee kabajuu dadhabuu irraa kan ka'e diigamuuf akka jiru mana maree nageenyaa UN-tti ibseera. Boordichi tarkaanfiin waraana Israa'el fi daangaan gargaarsa namoomaa irratti godhamaa jiru, jireenya namoota buqqa'anii rakkoo cimaa keessa jiran caalaatti hammeesseera jedheera. Waliigaltee kanaan dura turee fi haala lafa irra jiru gidduutti garagarummaan jiraachuun isaa, dhaabbii waraana kanaa kan shakkiif saaxile ta'uu fi tarkaanfiin ariifachiisaan yoo hin fudhatamne waliigalteen kun diigamuu akka danda'u hubachiiseera.

title: How the attack on Crimean Bridge unfolded
english: Ukraine successfully destroyed a key section of the Crimean Bridge through a sophisticated seven-stage military operation. By systematically neutralizing Russian air defenses and radar systems over several weeks, Ukrainian forces cleared a path for a final, precise missile strike. This attack highlights Ukraine's increasing capability to penetrate Russia's strongest defenses and target infrastructure vital to their occupation.
amharic: ዩክሬን በሰባት ደረጃ በተከፈለ ውስብስብ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን የክራይሚያን ድልድይ ወሳኝ ክፍል ማውደም ችላለች። የዩክሬን ኃይሎች ለበርካታ ሳምንታት የሩሲያን የአየር መከላከያ እና የራዳር ሲስተሞች በተከታታይ በመምታት ለዋናው የሮኬት ጥቃት አመቺ ሁኔታን ፈጥረዋል። ይህ ጥቃት ዩክሬን የሩሲያን ጠንካራ መከላከያ ሰብሮ በመግባት ስልታዊ ጠቀሜታ ያላቸውን መሠረተ ልማቶች መምታት እንደምትችል ያሳያል።
oromo: Yukireen duula waraanaa sadarkaa torba qabuun daandii gubbaa biyya Kirimeya kutaa barbaachisaa ta'e diiguu dandeesseetti. Humnoonni Yukireen torbanoota hedduuf sirna ittisa qilleensaa fi raadaaroota Raashiyaa irratti xiyyeeffachuun, dhukaasa rookeettii dhumaaf haala mijataa uumaniiru. Hojiin kun Yukireen ittisa Raashiyaa kan jabaa ta'e cabsitee bu'uuraalee misoomaa humnichaaf barbaachisoo ta'an rukutuuf dandeettii akka qabdu kan agarsiisuudha.
